publicvariable.name: publicVariable
publicvariable.description: Broadcasts missionNamespace variable and its value to all computers. The data is sent consequently and reliably to all clients. Using publicVariable too frequently in a given period of time can cause other parts of the game to experience bandwidth problems.

velocity.name: velocity
velocity.description: Return velocity (speed vector) of Unit as an array with format [x, y, z].

ctrlenable.name: ctrlEnable
ctrlenable.description: Enable or disable a control of the currently active user dialog. Disabled controls cannot be clicked onto. Read Dialog Control for more information about user dialogs and controls.

params.name: enable
params.description: true to enable the control, false to disable it

queryweaponpool.name: queryWeaponPool
queryweaponpool.description: Return number of weapons of type name in weapon pool (used in campaign to transfer weapons into next mission).

camdestroy.name: camDestroy
camdestroy.description: Destroys camera object created with camCreate. This command doesn't need camCommit.

count.name: count
count.example: _cnt = count [0,0,1,2]; // returns 4 _cnt = count units group player; // returns number of units in player group

leftParam.name: condition
leftParam.description:
condition that must return true for the tested element to be counted. The variable `_x` will contain the currently tested element
If the provided array contains different data types, use isEqualTo for item comparison instead of ==.

params.name: condition
params.description:
condition that must return true for the tested element to be counted. The variable `_x` will contain the currently tested element
If the provided array contains different data types, use isEqualTo for item comparison instead of ==.

sliderspeed.name: sliderSpeed
sliderspeed.description: Return speed, as an Array [min, max] of slider idc of topmost user dialog.

enemy.name: enemy
enemy.description: Enemy side (enemy to all units). This command is not functional and appears to have be replaced by sideEnemy.

globalchat.name: globalChat
globalchat.description: Types text to the global radio channel. The text will be visible only on the PC where command was executed. If you need the message to show on all computers, you have to execute it globally (see remoteExec)

titletext.name: titleText
titletext.description:
Displays text across the screen. If used along with cutText two different texts (in different type styles) can be shown at once. The text can be displayed on multiple lines by using "
" new line characters: titleText ["line1
line2
line3", "PLAIN"];. Since Arma 3 v1.73.142260 this command supports Structured Text formatting.

params.name: type
params.description: one of "PLAIN", "PLAIN DOWN", "BLACK", "BLACK FADED", "BLACK OUT", "BLACK IN", "WHITE OUT" and "WHITE IN". See Title Effect Types for more information about these values.

params.name: speed
params.description: time in seconds to fade in resource

params.name: showInMap
params.description: false to hide the text when the map is opened

params.name: isStructuredText
params.description: true to switch support for Structured Text formatting - see #Example 4

removeweapon.name: removeWeapon
removeweapon.description: Remove weapon from a unit. The unit must be local to the computer where command is executed. For a global version of this command see removeWeaponGlobal. Note: It is possible to create invalid combinations with this command (ie, attempting to remove a weapon that a unit does not possess). When doing so, application behaviour is undefined.

params.name: autoselect
params.description: false to abort weapon autoselection when removing primary weapon.

onbriefingnotes.name: onBriefingNotes
onbriefingnotes.description: Select a sound declared in the Description.ext of the mission to be played the first time the Notes tab is selected in the briefing.

engineon.name: engineOn
engineon.description: Activates and deactivates the engine of a vehicle. This command has to be executed where vehicle is local. NOTE: Executed on a remote vehicle this command may turn the engine on but then it will get turned off by itself after a short while.

rightParam.name: state
rightParam.description: true to turn the engine on, false to turn it off

params.name: state
params.description: true to turn the engine on, false to turn it off

deleteidentity.name: deleteIdentity
deleteidentity.description: Delete an identity (created with saveIdentity) from the campaign's progress file.

syntaxes.returnDescription: true if the identity was deleted successfully, false if not

atan.name: atan
atan.description: ArcTangent of a number, result in Degrees.

syntaxes.returnDescription: result is in degrees

onbriefingplan.name: onBriefingPlan
onbriefingplan.description: Select a sound declared in the Description.ext of the mission to be played the first time the Plan tab is selected in the briefing.

setgroupid.name: setGroupId
setgroupid.description: Sets a group's identity, how it will be displayed in chat, for example. While groups on the different sides can have identical ids, the groups on the same side cannot.
setgroupid.example: player setGroupId ["Some name for the group"];

addweaponcargo.name: addWeaponCargo
addweaponcargo.description: Add weapons to the cargo space of vehicles, which can be taken out by infantry units. Ignores available cargo space.

leftParam.name: vehicleName
leftParam.description: vehicle to which add the weapons

params.name: vehicleName
params.description: vehicle to which add the weapons

params.name: weaponName
params.description: weapon name. See :Category:Weapons for reference about possible values

params.name: count
params.description: number of weapons to add. {{GVI|arma3|2.14|size= 0.75}} negative count will remove weapons.

allowfleeing.name: allowFleeing
allowfleeing.description: Sets the cowardice level (the lack of courage or bravery) of a group or unit. The more cowardice a Group or Object has, the sooner it will start fleeing. 0 means maximum courage, while 1 means always fleeing.

rightParam.name: cowardice
rightParam.description: 1 is maximum cowardice and 0 minimum. A value of 0 will disable fleeing all together

params.name: cowardice
params.description: 1 is maximum cowardice and 0 minimum. A value of 0 will disable fleeing all together

deletevehicle.name: deleteVehicle
deletevehicle.description: Deletes an object. Only objects inserted in the mission editor and objects created during the game's progress can be deleted by this command. Island objects and player cannot be removed.

addscore.name: addScore
addscore.description: Add a number to the score of a unit. This score is shown in multiplayer in the "I" ("P" in Arma 3) screen. Negative values will remove from the score. Server execution only.

setflagtexture.name: setFlagTexture
setflagtexture.description: Sets flag texture. If texture is "", flag is not drawn.

flagowner.name: flagOwner
flagowner.description: Returns the global owner of a flag. A getter for setFlagOwner. Note that owner of a flag is Object rather than Number, as how it is usually with other owner commands

syntaxes.returnDescription: the person or vehicle that owns the flag is returned. If used on anything else than a flag, the returned value is objNull. If the flag is on its pole, the return value is NULL. If the flagowner is dead, the return value is the name of the soldier model

titlecut.name: titleCut
titlecut.description: this command was obsoleted, use cutText instead.

params.name: text
params.description: text to be displayed on screen

params.name: type
params.description: can be one of Title Effect Types

loadidentity.name: loadIdentity
loadidentity.description: Loads person's identity from Objects.sav file in campaign directory (from entry name).

syntaxes.returnDescription: true if successfull, otherwise false

or.name: or
or.description: Returns true only if one or both conditions are true. In case of the alternative syntax, lazy evaluation is used (if left operand is true, evaluation of the right side is skipped completely). Identical to: a || b

rightParam.name: b
rightParam.description: code that returns Boolean. It is not evaluated if ''a'' returns true

params.name: b
params.description: code that returns Boolean. It is not evaluated if ''a'' returns true

createdialog.name: createDialog
createdialog.description: Create a dialog which is defined either in the mission's description.ext, in the campaign's description.ext or in the global resource.cpp. The given name has to be the class name used in one of these files. If another dialog is already opened, the desired dialog is created as a child dialog of the one already opened.
createdialog.example: _ok = createDialog "RscDisplayGame"; if (!_ok) then {hint "Dialog couldn't be opened!"};

rightParam.name: dialogName
rightParam.description: class name used in the description.ext, resource.cpp or config.cpp

params.name: dialogName
params.description: class name used in the description.ext, resource.cpp or config.cpp

syntaxes.returnDescription: true when the dialog was created successfully

params.name: dialogName
params.description: class name used in the description.ext, resource.cpp or config.cpp

params.name: forceOnTop
params.description: if true, dialog will be rendered on top of displays

syntaxes.returnDescription: created dialog

textlog.name: textLog
textlog.description: Dump argument value to debugging output.

lightison.name: lightIsOn
lightison.description: Check if lampost is on (shining). For working with CfgNonAIVehicles class "StreetLamp" only. Possible values are:

syntaxes.returnDescription:
can be one of:
* '''"ON"''' - light is on
* '''"OFF"''' - light is off
* '''"AUTO"''' - applicable only to the light of type "StreetLamp" and is only on during the night.
* '''"ERROR"''' - if command fails

mapanimdone.name: mapAnimDone
mapanimdone.description: Check if map animation is finished.

camsettarget.name: camSetTarget
camsettarget.description: Set the target object or position where the given camera should point at. Needs the call of camCommit to be conducted.

exp.name: exp
exp.description: Let x be a number, then exp (x) is equal to e to the power of x (or e^x)

syntaxes.returnDescription: result in degrees

animate.name: animate
animate.description: Activates given object animation. Animation is defined in CfgModels Animations class of model.cfg or another model config. Since Arma 3 v1.65.138459 speed of animation can be altered with coefficient.

params.name: animationName
params.description: name of the animation. This is the class-name of the animation defined in the config

params.name: phase
params.description: range 0 (start point of the animation) to 1 (end point of the animation). The speed, in which the animation is processed, is defined in the addon's config.cpp and cannot be changed during running missions

params.name: speed
params.description: when true animation is instant; Number > 0 is treated as config speed value multiplier

playersnumber.name: playersNumber
playersnumber.description: Returns count of occupied role selection slots for given side. Players who claimed a slot in the lobby but didn't start the mission are counted as well. If disabledAI = 0; in description.ext or Enable AI option is checked in 3DEN, AI bots will be treated as valid players and will be counted too. Multiplayer only, in singleplayer always returns 0.
playersnumber.example: _west = playersNumber west; _east = playersNumber east; _civ = playersNumber civilian; hint format ["West:%1 East:%2, Civ:%3", _west, _east, _civ];

cuttext.name: cutText
cuttext.syntax: cutText [text, type, speed, showInMap, isStructuredText, drawOverHUD]
cuttext.description: Displays a text message in the center of the screen. The text can be displayed on multiple lines by using "\n" new line characters:

params.name: type
params.description: one of "PLAIN", "PLAIN DOWN", "BLACK", "BLACK FADED", "BLACK OUT", "BLACK IN", "WHITE OUT" and "WHITE IN". See Title Effect Types for more information about these values.

params.name: speed
params.description: time in seconds to fade in resource. If 0 or less, default value is used

params.name: showInMap
params.description: false to hide the text when the map is opened

params.name: isStructuredText
params.description: true to switch support for Structured Text formatting - see #Example 4

params.name: drawOverHUD
params.description: false to show the text under in-game HUD

syntaxes.signature: cutText [text, type, speed, showInMap, isStructuredText, drawOverHUD]

params.name: type
params.description: one of "PLAIN", "PLAIN DOWN", "BLACK", "BLACK FADED", "BLACK OUT", "BLACK IN", "WHITE OUT" and "WHITE IN". See Title Effect Types for more information about these values.

params.name: speed
params.description: time in seconds to fade in resource. If 0 or less, default value is used

params.name: showInMap
params.description: false to hide the text when the map is opened

params.name: isStructuredText
params.description: true to switch support for Structured Text formatting - see #Example 4

params.name: drawOverHUD
params.description: false to show the text under in-game HUD

syntaxes.signature: layer cutText [text, type, speed, showInMap, isStructuredText, drawOverHUD]

daytime.name: dayTime
daytime.description: Returns the current ingame time in hours.

syntaxes.returnDescription: day time using a 24 hour clock, using fractions of hours

benchmark.name: benchmark
benchmark.description: Returns the value of "3D Performance" in OFP Preferences (flashpoint.cfg). This can be used to estimate the computer performance to adapt CPU and GPU demanding settings like view distance dynamically in missions.

waypointposition.name: waypointPosition
waypointposition.description: Returns Position of the given waypoint.

markertype.name: markerType
markertype.description: Get type of marker. Note: This function is identical to getMarkerType. See cfgMarkers for a list of standard markers.
markertype.example: if (markerType "Marker1" == "Empty") then {hint "Marker1 is not an icon!"}

syntaxes.returnDescription: marker class name. See CfgMarkers.

addrating.name: addRating
addrating.description: Add a number to the rating of a unit - negative values can be used to reduce the rating.

isnull.name: isNull
isnull.description: Checks whether the tested item is Null.

setmimic.name: setMimic
setmimic.description: Set person's facial expression. Following mimic values are recognized:

crew.name: crew
crew.description: Returns the crew (both dead and alive) of the given vehicle.

syntaxes.returnDescription: an array with all units in the vehicle is returned.

land.name: land
land.description: Force helicopter landing. Landing mode may be:

assignasdriver.name: assignAsDriver
assignasdriver.description: Assign a unit as driver of a vehicle. Used together with orderGetIn to order subordinate units to get in as driver of a specific vehicle. Before usage of this command a subordinate unit hasn't got the option to get into the driver place of the vehicle.

cadetmode.name: cadetMode
cadetmode.description: Returns if the player is currently playing in cadet or veteran mode.

syntaxes.returnDescription: true when playing in cadet mode, false when playing in veteran mode

enableradio.name: enableRadio
enableradio.description: Enable and disable radio messages to be heard and shown in the left lower corner of the screen. This command can be helpful during cutscenes.

rightParam.name: state
rightParam.description: true to enable the radio, false to disable it

params.name: state
params.description: true to enable the radio, false to disable it

dostop.name: doStop
dostop.description: Order the given unit(s) to stop (without radio messages). The units stopped in this way will leave the groups formation. It will prevent them from moving around with their group (or formation leader), while still being able to turn around and even move to a new position if they see fit.

acos.name: acos
acos.description: ArcCosine of a number, result in Degrees

resize.name: resize
resize.description: Changes the size of the given array. The command does not return new array, it resizes the source array to the desired number of elements. If the new size is bigger than the current size, the new places are filled with nils.

fillweaponsfrompool.name: fillWeaponsFromPool
fillweaponsfrompool.description: Adds magazines from the campaign pool to the given unit, depending on his weapons.

comment.name: comment
comment.description: Define a comment. Mainly used in SQF Syntax, as you're able to introduce comment lines with semicolons in a SQS script.
comment.example: script.sqs comment "This is a commented line"

cutobj.name: cutObj
cutobj.description: Displays an object defined in the global config in CfgTitles.

params.name: class
params.description: the className of the object defined in `configFile >> "CfgTitles" >> class`

params.name: type
params.description: one of "PLAIN", "PLAIN DOWN", "BLACK", "BLACK FADED", "BLACK OUT", "BLACK IN", "WHITE OUT" and "WHITE IN". See Title Effect Types for more information about these values

params.name: speed
params.description: time in seconds to fade in resource

params.name: showInMap
params.description: false to hide the text when the map is opened

params.name: drawOverHUD
params.description: false to show the object under in-game HUD

leftParam.name: layer
leftParam.description: layer number on which the effect is shown, where 0 is the back most. Layer number is rounded to the nearest integer and also cannot be negative. Layer 99.5 will be treated as layer 100

params.name: layer
params.description: layer number on which the effect is shown, where 0 is the back most. Layer number is rounded to the nearest integer and also cannot be negative. Layer 99.5 will be treated as layer 100

params.name: class
params.description: the className of the object defined in `configFile >> "CfgTitles" >> class`

params.name: type
params.description: one of "PLAIN", "PLAIN DOWN", "BLACK", "BLACK FADED", "BLACK OUT", "BLACK IN", "WHITE OUT" and "WHITE IN". See Title Effect Types for more information about these values.

params.name: speed
params.description: time in seconds to fade in resource

params.name: showInMap
params.description: false to hide the text when the map is opened

params.name: drawOverHUD
params.description: false to show the object under in-game HUD

syntaxes.signature: layer cutObj [class, type, speed, showInMap, drawOverHUD]

leftParam.name: layerName
leftParam.description: layer name on which the effect is shown. Layer names are CaSe SeNsItIvE

params.name: layerName
params.description: layer name on which the effect is shown. Layer names are CaSe SeNsItIvE

params.name: class
params.description: the className of the object defined in `configFile >> "CfgTitles" >> class`

params.name: type
params.description: one of "PLAIN", "PLAIN DOWN", "BLACK", "BLACK FADED", "BLACK OUT", "BLACK IN", "WHITE OUT" and "WHITE IN". See Title Effect Types for more information about these values

params.name: speed
params.description: time in seconds to fade in resource

params.name: showInMap
params.description: false to hide the text when the map is opened

params.name: drawOverHUD
params.description: false to show the object under in-game HUD

syntaxes.returnDescription: number of the allocated layer
syntaxes.signature: layerName cutObj [class, type, speed, showInMap, drawOverHUD]

forceend.name: forceEnd
forceend.description: Sets the flag which tells engine that the mission end was forced. Might need additional endMission execution. Can be used in an "END" trigger to force end conditions in the editor.

buttonaction.name: buttonAction
buttonaction.description: Return the action assigned to a control of the currently active user dialog.

fleeing.name: fleeing
fleeing.description: Checks if a unit is fleeing.

syntaxes.returnDescription: returns true if a unit is fleeing, false if not. '''Dead''' or '''empty''' units return false.

setformdir.name: setFormDir
setformdir.description: Set group formation heading. Accepted heading range is 0 to 360. Formation is facing this direction unless enemy is seen. When group is moving, this value is overriden by movement direction.

countenemy.name: countEnemy
countenemy.description: Count how many units in the array are considered enemy to the given unit.

pickweaponpool.name: pickWeaponPool
pickweaponpool.description: Transfer weapons and magazines from cargo of object into weapon pool (used in campaign to transfer weapons into next mission).

setspeedmode.name: setSpeedMode
setspeedmode.description: Set group speed mode. Mode may be one of:

assignasgunner.name: assignAsGunner
assignasgunner.description: Assign a unit as gunner of a vehicle. Used together with orderGetIn to order subordinate units to get in as gunner of a specific vehicle. Before usage of this command a subordinate unit hasn't got the option to get into the gunner place of the vehicle.

missionstart.name: missionStart
missionstart.description: Returns date and time when mission started in format [year, month, day, hour, minute, second] in MP, which differs from date format only by seconds. In SP returns [0,0,0,0,0,0].

slidersetposition.name: sliderSetPosition
slidersetposition.description: Set current thumb position of slider idc of topmost user dialog.

object.name: object
object.description: Return Object with given id. Object ID's can be checked in mission editor.

camcommand.name: camCommand
camcommand.description: Executes a command on the given camera / actor object. Known commands for:

hint.name: hint
hint.description: Outputs a multi-line hint message in the left upper corner of the screen (in the right upper corner in Arma). This version of hint is supposed to play a sound when hint is shown, but this varies between games and versions. Use hintSilent for soundless hint. The effect of this command is local, i.e. the hint will only show on the computer command was executed.
hint.example: hint "Press W to move forward. \nPress S to move backwards."

fademusic.name: fadeMusic
fademusic.description: Changes the music volume smoothly within the given time.

setvelocity.name: setVelocity
setvelocity.description: Set velocity (speed vector) of a vehicle. Units are in metres per second.

vehicle.name: vehicle
vehicle.description: Vehicle in which given unit is mounted. If none, unit is returned. Alternatively, use objectParent
vehicle.example: SQS ? vehicle player != playerÂ : hint "Player is in a vehicle"

assignascommander.name: assignAsCommander
assignascommander.description: Assign a unit as commander of a vehicle. Used together with orderGetIn to order subordinate units to get in as commander of a specific vehicle. Before usage of this command a subordinate unit hasn't got the option to get into the commander place of the vehicle.

action.name: action
action.description: Make a unit to perform an action. Use the List of Actions for reference about the available actions and their syntax.

lock.name: lock
lock.description: Lock vehicle (disable mounting / dismounting) for player. Similar to setVehicleLock when number is used as param. This command will remove user get in/get out actions but will not stop player getting into or out of vehicle via script commands

rightParam.name: locked
rightParam.description: true to lock, false to unlock

params.name: locked
params.description: true to lock, false to unlock

rightParam.name: lockstate
rightParam.description:
can be one of the following:
0 - Unlocked
1 - Default (player subordinate cannot enter until his leader says so)
2 - Locked
3 - Locked for player

params.name: lockstate
params.description:
can be one of the following:
0 - Unlocked
1 - Default (player subordinate cannot enter until his leader says so)
2 - Locked
3 - Locked for player

switchlight.name: switchLight
switchlight.description: Controls whether a lamp is lit or not. For working with CfgNonAIVehicles class "StreetLamp" only.

rightParam.name: mode
rightParam.description: mode can be: "ON", "OFF" or "AUTO" (''lamp'' is on only during nighttime, default)

params.name: mode
params.description: mode can be: "ON", "OFF" or "AUTO" (''lamp'' is on only during nighttime, default)

animationphase.name: animationPhase
animationphase.description: Returns the phase of the given animation on the given object. Animation can be scripted (animate, animateSource, animateDoor) or engine driven. Animation names for an object could be found out with animationNames command. When animation is rotation, like with "MainTurret" for example, the output is in radians, to convert to degrees use deg command.
animationphase.example: _building animate ["maindoor",1]; sleep 1; _p = _building animationPhase "maindoor"; returns 1 (if the animation speed is <= 2 seconds)

rightParam.name: animationName
rightParam.description: name of the animation. This is the class-name of the animation defined in the addon's config.cpp

params.name: animationName
params.description: name of the animation. This is the class-name of the animation defined in the addon's config.cpp

syntaxes.returnDescription: where 0 is the start point of the animation and 0 is the end point

setrain.name: setRain
setrain.description: Set rain density smoothly over the given transition time (in seconds). A transition time of zero means an immediate change. A rain density of zero is no rain, one is maximum rain. Rain is not possible when overcast is less than 0.7.

leftParam.name: time
leftParam.description: transition time in seconds to the new value

params.name: time
params.description: transition time in seconds to the new value

rightParam.name: rainParams
rightParam.description: custom  `RainParticles` params - see rainParams. Use empty array [] to reset to default config values

params.name: rainParams
params.description: custom  `RainParticles` params - see rainParams. Use empty array [] to reset to default config values

rightParam.name: config
rightParam.description: config path to a custom class, which contains  `RainParticles` class. Use configNull to reset to default config values

params.name: config
params.description: config path to a custom class, which contains  `RainParticles` class. Use configNull to reset to default config values

titlersc.name: titleRsc
titlersc.description: Display a resource defined in RscTitles. Also see cutRsc, with these two commands you can show two different resources at once.

params.name: text
params.description: the class name of the resource. ("Default" will remove the current resource)

params.name: type
params.description: can be one of: "PLAIN", "PLAIN DOWN", "BLACK", "BLACK FADED", "BLACK OUT", "BLACK IN", "WHITE OUT" and "WHITE IN"; see Title Effect Types for more information about these values

params.name: speed
params.description: time in seconds to fade in resource

params.name: showInMap
params.description: false to hide the text when the map is opened

showcompass.name: showCompass
showcompass.description: Shows or hides the compass on the map screen, if enabled for the mission and you possess the item. (default true)

ctrlenabled.name: ctrlEnabled
ctrlenabled.description: Returns if a control on the currently active user dialog is enabled. Disabled controls cannot be focused. Read Dialog Control for more information about user dialogs and controls.

syntaxes.returnDescription: true if the control is enabled, false if not
true if the control is enabled, false if not

canfire.name: canFire
canfire.description: Returns true if the given vehicle is still able to fire. For the command to return true, vehicle must be alive, have weapon operator and the weapon cannot be damaged >= 0.9 but can be empty due to running out of ammo. If mission starts with vehicle having no ammo or setVehicleAmmo 0 command is executed on the vehicle, then canFire will always report false for it.

syntaxes.returnDescription: true if able to fire

setcombatmode.name: setCombatMode
setcombatmode.description: Set group combat mode (engagement rules). Modes: Blue, Green, White, Yellow and Red

leftParam.name: group
leftParam.description: if the argument is unit Object, unit's current group is used.

params.name: group
params.description: if the argument is unit Object, unit's current group is used.

cos.name: cos
cos.description: Cosine of a number, argument in degrees.

side.name: side
side.description: Returns the side of a unit, vehicle, object or location.
side.example: if (side player == west) then { hint "Player is on the West side" };

setobjecttexture.name: setObjectTexture
setobjecttexture.description: Textures object selection with texture named in array. Array has the form [selectionNumber, "Texture"].

params.name: selection
params.description: index of the selection. It is defined in the hiddenSelections array in the vehicle's config (starting with 0). If a string is given, it referes to a hiddenSelection name or clan selection instead of an index.

params.name: texture
params.description: path to texture. Since {{GVI|arma3|2.20}} using '''"#reset"''' would reset to default texture.

ctrlvisible.name: ctrlVisible
ctrlvisible.description: Returns if a control of the currently active user dialog is shown or not. Read Dialog Control for more information about user dialogs and controls.

syntaxes.returnDescription: true if the control is shown, false if not

nearestbuilding.name: nearestBuilding
nearestbuilding.description: Finds the nearest building to a given object or position. A "building" is defined as an object that is of class "House" and contains a path LOD.

syntaxes.returnDescription: see locationPosition

camcommit.name: camCommit
camcommit.description: Smoothly conduct the changes that were assigned to a camera within the given time. If the time is set to zero, the changes are done immediately.
camcommit.example: SQS; create a camera object _cam = "camera" camCreate [5600,4800,10] _cam camSetTarget player _cam cameraEffect ["internal", "BACK"] _cam camCommit 0 ; smoothly move the camera to its new position in 6 seconds _cam camSetPos [5680,4720,20] _cam camCommit 6 @camCommitted _cam ; proceed

rightParam.name: time
rightParam.description: time in seconds during which the changes shall be done

params.name: time
params.description: time in seconds during which the changes shall be done

setflagowner.name: setFlagOwner
setflagowner.description: Sets flag owner. When owner is set to objNull or any object other than a unit of class man or logic, flag is returned to the flagpole. A flag owned by a logic has no visual representation.

damage.name: damage
damage.description: Return the damage value of an object.

syntaxes.returnDescription: the returned number in range (healthy) 0..1 (dead).

sin.name: sin
sin.description: Sine of x, argument in Degrees.

missionname.name: missionName
missionname.description: Return currently loaded mission file (path to mission.pbo, relative to game exe).

gunner.name: gunner
gunner.description: Returns the gunner of a vehicle.

syntaxes.returnDescription: the person sitting in the gunner place is returned. If vehicle is not a vehicle but a person, the person is returned.

loadfile.name: loadFile
loadfile.description: Return content of given filename as string. If you plan to compile said string, be aware that the file shouldn't contain comments or compile will throw an error. If there are comments, use preprocessFile/preprocessFileLineNumbers instead.

setdir.name: setDir
setdir.description: Sets object heading. Angles are measured in degrees clockwise from north, and regular range goes from 0 to 360 (0Â° = N, 90Â° = E, 180Â° = S, 270Â° = W). Negative angles represent a counter-clockwise angle.
setdir.example: unit1 setDir 45; // will set unit1 to face North-East

disableuserinput.name: disableUserInput
disableuserinput.description: Disable and enable the keyboard and mouse input, usually used during cutscenes.

rightParam.name: state
rightParam.description: true to disable, false to enable

params.name: state
params.description: true to disable, false to enable

sliderposition.name: sliderPosition
sliderposition.description: Return current thumb position of slider idc of topmost user dialog.

removeaction.name: removeAction
removeaction.description: Removes user added action with given id index. This only removes actions added with the addAction command. You cannot remove default game actions, such as reload. This command has local effect. The action will only be removed on the computer that executes the command.

acctime.name: accTime
acctime.description: Returns the current time acceleration factor

locked.name: locked
locked.description: Check if vehicle is locked for Persons. If it is locked, Persons cannot mount / dismount without order.

syntaxes.returnDescription:
since {{GVI|arma3|0.50}}
** 0: Unlocked
** 1: Default - a subordinate player cannot enter without AI leader order
** 2: Locked
** 3: Locked for player
** -1: vehicle is null
* Boolean for older games

camsetrelpos.name: camSetRelPos
camsetrelpos.description: Sets the position of the given camera relative to its target, set with camSetTarget. Needs a call to camCommit to be conducted.

deg.name: deg
deg.description: Converts given value in radians to degrees. 1 degree equals 0.01745 radians or pi / 180.

syntaxes.returnDescription: degrees

showcinemaborder.name: showCinemaBorder
showcinemaborder.description: Forces drawing of cinema borders when using custom camera camCreate. This is normally used in cutscenes to indicate player has no control.

getworld.name: getWorld
getworld.description: Returns the name of the current map. Name is actually class as defined in config (eg Intro).
getworld.example: ; if testing on Everon, getWorld will return "eden" hint getWorld

setidentity.name: setIdentity
setidentity.description: Sets identity of a person. The identities could be defined in a custom config in Description.ext or in the main config. For a list of available main config values see CfgIdentities.

leftParam.name: person
leftParam.description: unit to which the identity will be applied

rightParam.name: identity
rightParam.description: name of the subclass in CfgIdentities

params.name: person
params.description: unit to which the identity will be applied

params.name: identity
params.description: name of the subclass in CfgIdentities

setfuel.name: setFuel
setfuel.description: Sets fuel percentage from 0 (empty) to 1 (full). The vehicle must be local to the computer where command is executed.

sideradio.name: sideRadio
sideradio.description: Sends the audio message to the side radio channel. Must have assigned "ItemRadio" to send or receive the transmission. The message is defined in CfgRadio in the description.ext file or config radio protocol. The transmission will play only on the PC where command was executed. If you need the transmission to play on all computers, you have to execute it globally (see remoteExec).

params.name: side
params.description: side to which the transmission will be played

showwatch.name: showWatch
showwatch.description: Shows or hides the watch on the map screen, if enabled for the mission and you possess the item. (default true)

vehiclechat.name: vehicleChat
vehiclechat.description: Types text to the vehicle radio channel. The text will be visible only on the PC where command was executed. If you need the message to show on all computers, you have to execute it globally (see remoteExec)

moveincommander.name: moveInCommander
moveincommander.description: Move soldier into vehicle commander position (Immediate, no animation).

playmusic.name: playMusic
playmusic.description: Plays music defined in Description.ext#CfgMusic or config.cpp. To stop the music execute playMusic "" or give the start time which is beyond the music duration playMusic ["SomeMusic", 1000];

params.name: start
params.description: start, in seconds. Can be negative.

markercolor.name: markerColor
markercolor.description: Returns marker color for given marker. See setMarkerColor.

disableai.name: disableAI
disableai.description: Disable parts of the AI behaviour to get a better control over the actions of a unit. Must be executed where AI unit is local. If unit changes locality, it might need to be executed again at the new locality to maintain effect. Possible values are:

goto.name: goto
goto.description: In SQS scripts only: Go to given label. String argument is used here. Be sure to use double quotes around label name in goto. Define the label with #. Note that Labels are not case sensitive and that labels are searched for from the top of the script, so multiple occurrences of a label will only result in the top most one ever being found.

commander.name: commander
commander.description: In OFP it returns the commander of a vehicle. Since ArmA and VBS2 it returns the primary observer. The commander of a vehicle can be found with effectiveCommander.

syntaxes.returnDescription: the unit sitting in the commander place is returned. If vehicle is not a vehicle but a person, the person is returned.

commandfollow.name: commandFollow
commandfollow.description: Order the given unit to follow the given other unit (via the radio).

lbsize.name: lbSize
lbsize.description: Return number of items of listbox or combobox with id idc of topmost user dialog.

friendly.name: friendly
friendly.description: Friendly side (friendly to all units). This command is not functional and appears to have be replaced by sideFriendly.

sidelogic.name: sideLogic
sidelogic.example: if (side _obj == sideLogic) then { hint "It's a logic!"; };

setunitpos.name: setUnitPos
setunitpos.description: Set unit position rules. Mode may be one of:

estimatedtimeleft.name: estimatedTimeLeft
estimatedtimeleft.description: Sets the estimated time left in the game that is shown in the "Game in progress" screen or in the master browser. This command will also force the server to broadcast serverTime to all clients ASAP, without waiting for the next broadcast window, which is about every 5 minutes.

rightParam.name: seconds
rightParam.description: estimated time in seconds, max 36000 (10 hours), 7200 (2 hours) before {{GVI|arma3|1.70|size= 0.75}}

params.name: seconds
params.description: estimated time in seconds, max 36000 (10 hours), 7200 (2 hours) before {{GVI|arma3|1.70|size= 0.75}}

ordergetin.name: orderGetIn
ordergetin.description: Force all units in the array to get in or out of their assigned vehicles. Units must be assigned to a vehicle before this command will do anything.

setdamage.name: setDamage
setdamage.description: Damage / repair object. Damage 0 means fully functional, damage 1 means completely destroyed / dead.

params.name: allowResurrection
params.description: - Will re-set alive state of previously dead object.

syntaxes.signature: object setDamage [damage, useEffects, killer, instigator, allowResurrection]

showngps.name: shownGPS
showngps.description: Checks if client has GPS reciever enabled in description.ext (showGPS param) or force enabled with showGPS command.
showngps.example: if (shownGPS) then {hint "You have GPS reciever enabled"};

switchmove.name: switchMove
switchmove.description: Applies given animation to a unit. When used on a person, the given move is started immediately (there is no transition). Use _unit switchMove ""; to reset animation. For a smooth transition use playMove.

params.name: time
params.description: normalized time, in range 0..1, where 0 = beginning of the animation, and 1 = end of the animation

params.name: blendFactor
params.description: how much to blend the current animation with the new animation, in range 0..1, where 0 = current animation, and 1 = new animation. When 1 is used, the switching is instant (not smooth), similar to the first syntax.

params.name: resetAim
params.description: whether the aim/head direction should be reset after switching

musicvolume.name: musicVolume
musicvolume.description: Checks the current music volume (set by fadeMusic)

requiredversion.name: requiredVersion
requiredversion.description: Check if version of application is available. If the current version is older than the required one, a warning message is shown and false is returned.

querymagazinepool.name: queryMagazinePool
querymagazinepool.description: Return number of magazines of type name in magazine pool (used in campaign to transfer magazines into next mission).

knowsabout.name: knowsAbout
knowsabout.description: Checks if a group or a side knows about target.

leftParam.name: who
leftParam.description: if a unit, unit's group is considered; if a vehicle, vehicle commander's group is used.

params.name: who
params.description: if a unit, unit's group is considered; if a vehicle, vehicle commander's group is used.

syntaxes.returnDescription: in range of 0..4, where 4 is maximum knowledge.

getmarkersize.name: getMarkerSize
getmarkersize.description: Returns the size of the given marker. A getter for setMarkerSize and an alias of markerSize.

syntaxes.returnDescription:
1/2 width of marker
* b_axis: Number - 1/2 height of marker

countside.name: countSide
countside.description: Count how many units in the given array belong to given side. If the object in passed array is a Group, the leader of the group will be counted.

moveindriver.name: moveInDriver
moveindriver.description: Move soldier into vehicle driver position (Immediate, no animation).

weapons.name: weapons
weapons.description: Returns array of names of all Unit's weapons.

syntaxes.returnDescription: weapon class names

fire.name: fire
fire.description: Forces a unit to fire the given weapon.

leftParam.description: unit that is supposed to fire

leftParam.description: existing group new unit will join; if the group is not local, a warning will be logged

params.description: classname of unit to be created as per CfgVehicles

lbpicture.name: lbPicture
lbpicture.description: Returns the picture name of the item with the given index of the listbox or combobox with id idc of the topmost user dialog.

loadstatus.name: loadStatus
loadstatus.description: Loads object's properties from Objects.sav file in campaign directory (from entry name).

syntaxes.returnDescription: true if successfull, otherwise false

getdammage.name: getDammage
getdammage.description: Returns the object damage in the range from 0 to 1. Alias of damage.

lbsetcursel.name: lbSetCurSel
lbsetcursel.description: Selects the item with the given index of the listbox or combobox with id idc of the topmost user dialog.

commandwatch.name: commandWatch
commandwatch.description: Orders the unit(s) to watch the given position or target (via the radio). Use objNull as the target to order a unit to stop watching a position/target

setradiomsg.name: setRadioMsg
setradiomsg.description: Sets radio trigger menu title text (0 -> 0 -> map radio). Use "NULL" to disable radio slot. Use "" to restore default title
setradiomsg.example: 1 setRadioMsg "Click meeeeeeeeee"; //changes title of radio Alpha

inflame.name: inflame
inflame.description: Control fireplace burning. Set inflame to true (on) or false (off).

rightParam.name: burn
rightParam.description: true to let it burn, false to extinguish it.

params.name: burn
params.description: true to let it burn, false to extinguish it.

domove.name: doMove
domove.description: Order the given unit(s) to move to the given position (without radio messages). After reaching his destination, the unit will immediately return to formation (if in a group); or order his group to form around his new position (if a group leader). Use doStop to stop units returning to formation.

commandmove.name: commandMove
commandmove.description: Order the given unit(s) to move to the given location (via the radio). Exactly the same as doMove, except this command displays a radio message.

addmagazine.name: addMagazine
addmagazine.description: Adds a magazine to a person. Infantry units can only carry a specific number of magazines, once the magazine slots are filled (or uniform/vest/bagpack are full in Arma3), any further addMagazine commands are ignored. If class of magazine does not exist, error message is printed in .rpt: player addMagazine "dasdsa"; // .rpt: Given magazine[dasdsa] not found)

leftParam.name: unitName
leftParam.description: person to add the magazines to

rightParam.name: magazineName
rightParam.description: magazine name. See the topic :Category:Weapons for reference about possible values.

params.description: person to add the magazines to

params.description: person to add the magazines to

params.name: ammoCount
params.description: ammo quantity to be added to magazine. If it goes beyond maximum magazine capacity, the magazine will be given full and not overloaded.

asin.name: asin
asin.description: Arcsine of a number, result in Degrees.

setflagside.name: setFlagSide
setflagside.description: Sets flag Side. A flag may be taken by any unit that is enemy to the side that owns the flag. Just like with setFlagTexture, if the command executed where unit is local effect of the command will be global and JIP compatible.

cheatsenabled.name: cheatsEnabled
cheatsenabled.description: Checks whether cheats are enabled (whether the designers' version is running).

skiptime.name: skipTime
skiptime.description: Jumps the specified number of hours forward or backward.

rightParam.name: duration
rightParam.description: hours to skip. A positive value will create a forward time jump, a negative value will jump backwards.

params.name: duration
params.description: hours to skip. A positive value will create a forward time jump, a negative value will jump backwards.

move.name: move
move.description: Let group move to given position (format Position or Position2D) without waypoint. Active waypoints will be ignored when command is used.

canstand.name: canStand
canstand.description: Returns if the given soldier is able to stand up.
canstand.example: SQS: ?!(canStand player)Â : player groupChat "My legs! They hit my legs!"

syntaxes.returnDescription: true if the unit is human and is still able to stand up, false otherwise.

countunknown.name: countUnknown
countunknown.description: Count how many units in the array are unknown to the given unit.

hasweapon.name: hasWeapon
hasweapon.description: Checks if a unit has the given weapon.

rightParam.name: weaponName
rightParam.description: the name of the weapon to check for.

params.name: weaponName
params.description: the name of the weapon to check for.

syntaxes.returnDescription: returns true if the unit has the weapon, false if not.

deletestatus.name: deleteStatus
deletestatus.description: Delete a status (created with saveStatus) from the campaign's progress file.

syntaxes.returnDescription: true if the status was deleted successfully, false if not

setskill.name: setSkill
setskill.description: Sets ability level of person (commander unit). Value of skill may vary from 0 to 1.

addmagazinepool.name: addMagazinePool
addmagazinepool.description: Add magazines to the magazine pool, of which the player may choose in the following mission. Available in campaigns only.

params.name: magazineName
params.description: magazine class name. See the topic :Category:Weapons for reference about possible values.

fuel.name: fuel
fuel.description: Checks how much fuel is left in the gas tank of a vehicle.
fuel.example: if (fuel vehicle player == 0) then {hint "The vehicle is out of fuel!"};

syntaxes.returnDescription: 0 (empty tank) to 1 (full tank).

setfog.name: setFog
setfog.description: Changes the fog smoothly over the the given TransitionTime (in seconds). A time of zero means there will be an immediate change. A fog intensity of zero is minimum fog and a fog level of one is maximum fog.

leftParam.name: time
leftParam.description: transition time to the new value

params.name: time
params.description: transition time to the new value

leftParam.name: time
leftParam.description: transition time to the new value

params.name: time
params.description: transition time to the new value

params.name: fogValue
params.description: normal fog value that represents fog density at ''fogBase'' level, in range 0..1

params.name: fogDecay
params.description: decay of fog density with altitude, in range -1..1; a negative value means a "ceiling" fog

params.name: fogBase
params.description: base altitude (ASL) of fog (in meters), in range -5000..5000

local.name: local
local.description: Check if given unit is local on the computer in Multiplayer games (see Locality in Multiplayer for general concepts).

inflamed.name: inflamed
inflamed.description: Checks if fireplace is inflamed (burning) or not. To check if a unit is receiving damage from fire, use isBurning command.

combatmode.name: combatMode
combatmode.description: Returns the combat mode of the given unit. See setCombatMode for more information about combat modes.

syntaxes.returnDescription:
one of:
* "BLUE"
* "GREEN"
* "WHITE"
* "YELLOW"
* "RED"
* "ERROR"

commandtarget.name: commandTarget
commandtarget.description: Order the given unit(s) to target the given target (via the radio). Command given to the player, puts a red square with words Target and Distance on player's HUD at target location. If player in vehicle and has radar facilities, it also adds target marker to the radar.

groupchat.name: groupChat
groupchat.description: Types text to the group radio channel. Must have assigned "ItemRadio" to see or transmit the messages. The text will be visible only on the PC where command was executed. If you need the message to show on all computers, you have to execute it globally (see remoteExec)

camsetpos.name: camSetPos
camsetpos.description: Sets the position of the given camera or seagull (see camCreate). It is worth mentioning that camera position can also be set with setPos, in which case it would be instant. With camSetPos it is possible to make smooth position transition in time, defined with camCommit, which is required in this case.

isengineon.name: isEngineOn
isengineon.description: Returns true if engine is on, false if it is off.

clearweaponpool.name: clearWeaponPool
clearweaponpool.description: Remove all weapons from the weapon pool, of which the player may choose in the following missions. Available in campaigns only.

forcemap.name: forceMap
forcemap.description: Opens non-interactive main map in background that overrides user screen. The user is able to fire but cannot see the world just the map. To force open interactive map use openMap command.

rightParam.name: show
rightParam.description: true to force, false to go back to normal map behaviour

params.name: show
params.description: true to force, false to go back to normal map behaviour

setacctime.name: setAccTime
setacctime.description: Set time acceleration coefficient. May be also used to slow time in cutscenes. This command does NOT work in multiplayer. accFactor is clamped to [1/128; 4].

rightParam.name: accFactor
rightParam.description: time factor; 2 will make time go twice as fast, 0.5 half of it, etc

params.name: accFactor
params.description: time factor; 2 will make time go twice as fast, 0.5 half of it, etc

shownpad.name: shownPad
shownpad.description: Checks if client has Notepad enabled.

getdir.name: getDir
getdir.description: Returns the object heading in the range from 0 to 360.

addweaponpool.name: addWeaponPool
addweaponpool.description: Add weapons to the weapon pool, of which the player may choose in the following mission. Available in campaigns only.

params.name: weaponName
params.description: weapon name. See the topic :Category:Weapons for reference about possible values.

dofire.name: doFire
dofire.description: Order the given unit(s) to fire on the given target (without radio messages). The target is set with doTarget or commandTarget. The target can be a unit or a vehicle, but not an object.

lbcursel.name: lbCurSel
lbcursel.description: Returns the index of the selected item of the listbox or combobox with id idc of the topmost user dialog. For listbox LB_MULTI (multi-selection) use lbSelection.

syntaxes.returnDescription: selected index (row) or -1 if nothing is selected
selected index (row) or -1 if nothing is selected

onmapsingleclick.name: onMapSingleClick
onmapsingleclick.description: Define action performed when user clicks in map by executing command string. the string receives 5 (localised in scope) variables:
onmapsingleclick.example: onMapSingleClick "'SoldierWB' createUnit [_pos, group player]; true"; ArmA: Creates a soldier unit at the position clicked.

alive.name: alive
alive.description: Check if given vehicle/person/building is alive (i.e. not dead or destroyed). alive objNull returns false.

syntaxes.returnDescription: true if alive, false if dead/destroyed

speedmode.name: speedMode
speedmode.description: Returns speed mode of the group, which can be any of the following:

atan2.name: atan2
atan2.description: ArcTangent of x/y. Used to determine the angle of a vector [x,y]. Result in Degrees between -180 and 180.

camsetbank.name: camSetBank
camsetbank.description: Sets camera bank angle. Does not commit changes.

camcreate.name: camCreate
camcreate.description: Create a camera or a seagull object on the given position. Also other objects can be created this way, but vehicles created with camCreate cannot be entered. Any units created with camCreate will remain static. Differently to createVehicle, objects are created without consideration of the collision detection with surrounding objects, thus the objects are spawned exactly at the given position. camCreate is conducted immediately, the command doesn't wait for camCommit

rightParam.name: position
rightParam.description: position at which to create the object

params.name: position
params.description: position at which to create the object

syntaxes.returnDescription: the created camera

saveidentity.name: saveIdentity
saveidentity.description: Saves person's identity to Objects.sav file in campaign directory as entry name.

syntaxes.returnDescription: true if successful, otherwise false

debuglog.name: debugLog
debuglog.description: Dump argument type and value to debugging output.

allowgetin.name: allowGetIn
allowgetin.description: Set if the units given in the list are allowed to enter vehicles.

rightParam.name: allow
rightParam.description: true allows the units to enter, false denies them

params.name: allow
params.description: true allows the units to enter, false denies them

ctrltext.name: ctrlText
ctrltext.description: Returns the text of a control of the currently active user dialog. This command can be used on static texts, buttons, edit lines and active texts as well as for images, where it returns the image path. Does not work on HTML control and returns empty string "".

the text or image path or texture is returned, dependent on the control type

random.name: random

setcaptive.name: setCaptive
setcaptive.description: Mark a unit as captive. If unit is a vehicle, commander is marked. A captive is neutral to everyone (belong to civilian side), and will not trigger "detected by" conditions for its original side.

rightParam.name: statusNumber
rightParam.description: zero means non-captive, a non-zero value means captive; see captiveNum

localize.name: localize
localize.description: Used to internationalise text messages. A string is returned from Stringtable.csv (or Stringtable.xml) which corresponds to the stringName.

rightParam.description: string which leads to localisation. Casing does not matter. {{GVI|arma3|2.04|size= 0.75}} A string starting with "$" is supported

params.description: string which leads to localisation. Casing does not matter. {{GVI|arma3|2.04|size= 0.75}} A string starting with "$" is supported

setammocargo.name: setAmmoCargo
setammocargo.description: Set amount of ammo resources in cargo space of a rearm vehicle. Ammo resource is used to resupply vehicles that take ammo. Soldiers use individual magazines instead. Amount: 1 is full cargo. The

setfaceanimation.name: setFaceAnimation
setfaceanimation.description: Set facial animation phase (eye blinking), blink is in the range from 0 to 1.

setovercast.name: setOvercast
setovercast.description: Set overcast to given value smoothly during given time (in seconds). Zero time means immediate change. An overcast setting of zero means clear (sunny) weather, and one means storms and rain are very likely. Higher overcast values also result in higher wind speeds.

setformation.name: setFormation
setformation.description: Set group formation. Formation is one of:

groupradio.name: groupRadio
groupradio.description: Sends the audio message to the group radio channel. Must have assigned "ItemRadio" to send or receive the transmission. The message is defined in CfgRadio in the description.ext file or config radio protocol. The transmission will play only on the PC where command was executed. If you need the transmission to play on all computers, you have to execute it globally (see remoteExec).

leader.name: leader
leader.description: Returns the group leader for the given unit or group. For dead units, objNull is returned.

lbsetcolor.name: lbSetColor
lbsetcolor.description: Sets the color of the item (left) with the given index of the listbox or combobox with id idc of the topmost user dialog to color.

vehicleradio.name: vehicleRadio
vehicleradio.description: Sends the audio message to the vehicle radio channel. The message is defined in CfgRadio in the description.ext file or config radio protocol. The transmission will play only on the PC where command was executed. If you need the transmission to play on all computers, you have to execute it globally (see remoteExec).

addaction.name: addAction

To avoid this use `&lt;` for '''<''' and `&gt;` for '''>'''. The title text appearance can be changed with setUserActionText

params.name: arguments
params.description: arguments to pass to the script. Accessible with `_this select 3` inside the script. If Array is used as an argument for example, its first element reference would be `_this select 3 select 0`

params.name: priority
params.description: priority value of the action. Actions will be arranged in descending order according to this value. Every game action has a preset priority value. Value can be negative or decimal fraction. Actions with same values will be arranged in order which they were made, newest at the bottom. The bigger the number the higher the action will be positioned on the menu. Typical range is 0 to 6

params.name: showWindow
params.description: if set to true, players see "Titletext" at mid-lower screen, as they approach the object. Only the title text for the action with highest priority and ''showWindow'' set to true will be shown

params.name: hideOnUse
params.description: if set to true, it will hide the action menu after selecting it. If set to false, it will leave the action menu open and visible after selecting the action, leaving the same action highlighted, for the purpose of allowing you to re-select that same action quickly, or to select another action

params.name: shortcut
params.description: one of the key names defined in bin.pbo (e.g. "moveForward"). Adding available shortcut will bind corresponding keyboard key to this action. Shortcut availability can be tested with inputAction command

params.name: radius
params.description: maximum 3D distance in meters between the activating unit's eyePos and ''object'''s ''memoryPoint'', ''selection'' or position. -1 disables the radius; hardcoded limit is '''50'''

params.name: unconscious
params.description: if true will be shown to incapacitated player. See also setUnconscious and lifeState

params.name: memoryPoint
params.description: ''object'''s memory point. If ''selection'' is supplied, ''memoryPoint'' is not used

syntaxes.returnDescription: the added action's ID. Action can be removed with removeAction (see also removeAllActions). IDs are incrementing, the first given action to each unit has the ID 0, the second the ID 1, etc. IDs are also passed to the called script (see the ''script'' parameter)
syntaxes.signature: object addAction [title, script, arguments, priority, showWindow, hideOnUse, shortcut, condition, radius, unconscious, selection, memoryPoint]

sliderrange.name: sliderRange
sliderrange.description: Return limits, as an Array [min, max] of slider idc of topmost user dialog.

commandfire.name: commandFire
commandfire.description: Order the given unit to fire on the given target (via the radio). If the target is objNull, the unit is ordered to fire on its current target (set with doTarget or commandTarget).

setmarkertype.name: setMarkerType
setmarkertype.description: Set marker type. See cfgMarkers for a list of standard markers.

setterraingrid.name: setTerrainGrid
setterraingrid.description: Operation Flashpoint, VBS1: Set desired terrain resolution (in meters). For default landscapes, supported resolutions are:

lbsetdata.name: lbSetData
lbsetdata.description: Sets the additional text (invisible) in the item with the given index of the listbox or combobox with id idc of the topmost user dialog to the given data.

counttype.name: countType
counttype.description: Count how many objects in the array are of given type. This command also works with parent classes like "Air", "Tank", and "Car". For a full class reference see Classes.

setdammage.name: setDammage
setdammage.description: Damage / repair object. Damage 0 means fully functional, damage 1 means completely destroyed / dead.

camsetdir.name: camSetDir
camsetdir.description: Sets the orientation of the given camera in the direction of the given vector. Needs camCommit.
camsetdir.example: pos1 = player modelToWorld [0,5,5]; cam = "camera" camCreate pos1; cam cameraEffect ["INTERNAL", "BACK"]; pos2 = player modelToWorld [0,50,50]; cam camSetPos pos2; cam camSetDir (pos2 vectorFromTo pos1); cam camCommit 5; 0 = [] spawn { waitUntil {camCommitted cam}; cam camSetPos pos1; cam camCommit 5; };

rightParam.name: direction
rightParam.description: direction of camera. Must be a valid vector.

params.name: direction
params.description: direction of camera. Must be a valid vector.

score.name: score
score.description: Returns the person's score in MP.

getpos.name: getPos
getpos.description: Returns the object position in format PositionAGLS. Z value is height over the surface underneath.

syntaxes.returnDescription: where Z is the height over the surface underneath
see locationPosition
the Z value is '''terrain level Above Ground Level''', either 0 over land or getTerrainHeightASL (negative value) over water

direction.name: direction
direction.description: Returns the direction an object or a location is facing (differs from getDir in that this also works with locations).

syntaxes.returnDescription: Direction in degrees

typeof.name: typeOf
typeof.description: Returns the config class name of given object or "" if object doesn't have config class.

units.description: Returns an array with all the units in the group or group of the unit.

syntaxes.returnDescription: if ''type'' is a destroyed object, an empty array is returned

savevar.name: saveVar
savevar.description: Save variable value into the campaign space. This variable is available to all following missions in the campaign.

addmagazinecargo.name: addMagazineCargo
addmagazinecargo.description: Add magazines to the cargo space of vehicles, which can be taken out by infantry units. Once the magazine cargo space is filled up, any further addMagazineCargo commands are ignored.

leftParam.description: vehicle to add the magazines to

params.name: vehicleName

params.description: number of magazines to add. {{GVI|arma3|2.14|size= 0.75}} negative count will remove magazines.

showgps.name: showGPS
showgps.description: Shows or hides the GPS receiver on the map screen, if enabled for the mission and you possess the item. (default false)

showpad.name: showPad
showpad.description: Shows or hides the notebook on the map screen, if enabled for the mission. (default true). It is no longer relevant to Arma 2.

mod.name: mod
mod.description: Remainder of a divided by b.

list.name: list
list.description: List of units that would activate given Trigger. It returns nothing before the simulation started, i.e. in (undelayed) init.sqf files. Returns a pointer to the trigger's list after the simulation started.

getmarkercolor.name: getMarkerColor
getmarkercolor.description: Returns marker color for given marker. See setMarkerColor.

flyinheight.name: flyInHeight
flyinheight.description: Sets the flying altitude for aircraft relatively to the ground surface. Avoid too low altitudes, as helicopters and planes won't evade trees and obstacles on the ground. The default flying altitude is 100 meters.

params.name: forced
params.description: true to force altitude in all cases, false to behave like main syntax

time.name: time
time.description: Returns time elapsed since mission started (in seconds). The value is different on each client. If you need unified time, use serverTime.

commandstop.name: commandStop
commandstop.description: Order the given unit(s) to stop (via the radio).

onbriefinggear.description: Select a sound declared in the Description.ext of the mission to be played the first time the Gear tab is selected in the briefing.

fadesound.description: Changes the sound volume smoothly within the given time.

index (row) of newly added item

globalradio.description: Sends the audio message to the global radio channel. The message is defined in CfgRadio in the description.ext file or config radio protocol. The transmission will play only on the PC where command was executed. If you need the transmission to play on all computers, you have to execute it globally (see remoteExec).

addeventhandler.name: addEventHandler
addeventhandler.description: Adds event handler (EH) to the given object and returns EH handle. If EH has some data to return upon event (e.g. the "killed" EH will return an array with 2 elements: the killed unit, and the killer), it is passed in _this variable. one of:

* "COMBAT"
* "STEALTH"
* "ERROR" (Since {{GVI|Arma3|1.78}} when used on empty vehicles and such)

can be one of:

* 4 - Launched

rating.description: Check unit rating. Rating is increased for killing enemies, decreased for killing friendlies (see Rating Values). Can be changed via addRating by the mission designer. The rating of the player is displayed as the "score" at the end of the mission. Via Description.ext one can define how many points it takes to get a perfect score, as well as the number of stars.

dowatch.name: doWatch
dowatch.description: Order the given unit(s) to watch the given position or target (without radio messages). Use objNull as the target to order a unit to stop watching a position/target.
dowatch.example: _soldierOne doWatch markerPos "MarkerMoveOne" The unit named "soldierOne" will watch the position where the marker "MarkerMoveOne" is placed.

driver.name: driver
driver.description: Returns the driver of a vehicle.

syntaxes.returnDescription: The unit sitting in the driver place is returned. If vehicle is not a vehicle but a person, the person is returned.

rad.name: rad
rad.description: Converts given value in degrees to radians. 1 radian equals 180 degrees divided by pi.

syntaxes.returnDescription: radians

magazines.name: magazines
magazines.description: Returns array of type names of all vehicle's magazines. When applied to a unit (soldier), the command behaves differently and will omit magazines already loaded into unit's weapons. Use currentMagazine to get this information for a currently loaded magazine.

moveingunner.name: moveInGunner
moveingunner.description: Move soldier into vehicle gunner position (Immediate, no animation).

skill.name: skill
skill.description: Returns current level of ability of a unit, in range between 0 and 1, 1 being the highest level of skill.

putweaponpool.name: putWeaponPool
putweaponpool.description: Transfer weapons and magazines from weapon pool into cargo of object obj. Used in campaign to transfer weapons into next mission.

unassignvehicle.name: unassignVehicle
unassignvehicle.description: Unassigns individual unit from a vehicle, i.e removes assignedVehicleRole of the unit. If the unit is currently in that vehicle, the group leader will issue an order to disembark.

setfuelcargo.name: setFuelCargo
setfuelcargo.description: Sets fuel amount in cargo space of refuel vehicle from empty (0) to full (1) Note, the carrying capacity of each side's refuel trucks differ.

setface.name: setFace
setface.description: Set person's face. For a list of available faces, check Category:CfgIdentities.

captive.name: captive
captive.description: Returns the captive state of the given unit (set with setCaptive). A captive unit will not be attacked by its enemies.

syntaxes.returnDescription: true if the unit is captive, false if not

lbvalue.name: lbValue

only integers

drop.name: drop
drop.description: Creates a particle effect. This command is used to create smoke, fire and similar effects. The particles are single polygons with single textures that always face the player. They can be set to dynamically change their position, size, direction, can be set to different weights and more or less dependant on the wind.

savegame.name: saveGame
savegame.description: Autosaves the game (used for Retry). The game can then be loaded from the last autosave with loadGame. Will not save if the player is null or dead.

distance c calculated as c = sqrt(a * a + b * b);

hintc.name: hintC
hintc.description: Displays attractive hint in the center of the screen. Player control is taken away until user presses "Continue". After user confirmation, the content of the hintC is repeated again in a normal hint. This type of hint can also have a title. It is also possible to drag this type of hint around the screen.

setbehaviour.name: setBehaviour
setbehaviour.description: Sets group behaviour mode. If a unit is given as argument, behaviour is set for the unit's group. Behaviour is one of:

lbcolor.description: Returns the text color of the item with the given index of the listbox or combobox with id idc of the topmost user dialog.

handshit.name: handsHit
handshit.description: Checks if a soldier's hands are hit, which results in inaccurate aiming.
handshit.example: ? (handsHit player == 1)Â : player globalChat "Ouch! Don't shoot at my hands dammit!"

syntaxes.returnDescription: if the hands are not damaged, the returned value is 0. If the hands are hit or the unit is dead, the returned value is 1.

onbriefinggroup.name: onBriefingGroup
onbriefinggroup.description: Select a sound declared in the Description.ext of the mission to be played the first time the Group tab is selected in the briefing.

createvehicle.name: createVehicle
createvehicle.description: Creates an empty object of given classname type (See Arma 3 Assets or createVehicle/vehicles). Cannot be used to create objects of type "Logic", use createUnit command for that.

setviewdistance.name: setViewDistance

say.description: Unit will say given sound. When the Unit is a Person, it will also perform corresponding lipsync effect provided an appropriate .lip file has been created for this sound. A unit that has been killed or does not exist will not say anything. Compare this with playSound which will always play a sound at the location of the player. If the camera is not within given range, title is not shown and the sound will not be heard. Sound is defined in CfgSound of the Description.ext.

bis_fnc_guihint.description: Creates advanced hintC dialog Parameter(s): _this select 0: ARRAY in format [text,picture] * text: STRING - hint text * picture: STRING - picture [item1,item2...] - Listbox item ARRAYs in format [itemText,itemDescription,picture,icon] * itemText: STRING - Text displayed in listbox * itemDescription (Optional): STRING - text displayed after clicking on item * picture (Optional): STRING - picture displayed after clicking on item * icon (Optional): STRING - icon displayed in listbox left from text _this select 1 (Optional): STRING - hint header _this select 2 (Optional): ARRAY - [STRING,CODE,NUMBER] - text on left button (when "", button is hidden), code executed upon clicking and fade out delay. If only text is present, button is disabled. _this select 3 (Optional): ARRAY - [STRING,CODE,NUMBER] - STRING - text on right button and code executed upon clicking _this select 4 (Optional): ARRAY - [STRING,CODE,NUMBER] - STRING - text on middle button and code executed upon clicking _this select 5 (Optional): NUMBER or ARRAY - width or [width,height] of picture (in grid coordinates). Width > 17 means only picture is used. Returns: ARRAY - [endState(,lbId)] * endState: NUMBER - 1 when clicked on right button, -1 when clicked on left button, 0 when escaped * lbId: NUMBER - selected listbox item (when listbox was used) */ #define DISPLAY_CLASS 'Hsim_RscDisplayCommonHint_guiHint' #define DISPLAY_CONFIG (configfile >> "RscDisplayCommonHint") #define DISPLAY (uinamespace getvariable DISPLAY_CLASS) #define CONTROL (DISPLAY displayctrl _idc) #define CONTROL_FADEINTIME 0.3 #define CONTROL_FADEIN \ CONTROL ctrlsetfade 1; \ CONTROL ctrlcommit 0; \ CONTROL ctrlsetfade 0; \ CONTROL ctrlcommit CONTROL_FADEINTIME;

bis_fnc_credits.description: Opens credits, identical to those found in main menu (Arma 3). Present in Arma 3.

setcustomweightrtd.description: Add virtual custom weight to a helicopter's center of gravity. This can be used to simulate added internal payload for specific scenarios, and affects the flight model.

bis_fnc_radiosetplaylist.description: Set a random music playlist for the current set channel (default "Rock"). Musics with "genre" set in CfgMusic are selected and shuffled.

bis_fnc_kmlimport.description: Read positions from a KML file.

bis_fnc_displaycolorset.description: Applies custom color settings to given Display. Display must be already using color macros, function will just refresh the values according to current color settings.

bis_fnc_spawngroup.description: Function which handles the spawning of a dynamic group of characters. The composition of the group can be passed to the function. Alternatively a number can be passed and the function will spawn that amount of characters with a random type. A side's Center must have been created before a group may be spawned. Either by using createCenter or an editor placed (0% Probability of Presence is fine) unit of the appropriate side.
bis_fnc_spawngroup.example: Spawn five random EAST units at aPos: [ getPos aPos, EAST, 5] call BIS_fnc_spawnGroup

bis_fnc_movein.description: Moves a unit into vehicle. Compatible with assignedVehicleRole output.

bis_fnc_onload.description: Register code to be executed after a mission load (from a save, for example).

setstarterrtd.description: Toggle the starter for the given helicopter engine(s) on or off.

bis_fnc_displaymission.description: Returns main display of current mission/intro/outro. A cleaner alternative to findDisplay 46.

setwantedrpmrtd.name: setWantedRPMRTD
setwantedrpmrtd.description: Tell the helicopter engine RPMs to reach the given value within a period of time. The simulation will try to reach the RPMs, but it does not guarantee it will reach the precise value!

radiochannelcreate.name: radioChannelCreate
radiochannelcreate.description: Create a custom radio channel with the given color, label, call sign and registered characters. The index returned can be used to manipulate the created channel later. There are 10 slots for custom radio channels which would correspond to channels 6-15 (see getPlayerChannel). The command will find an unused index in this range and create it when found. Server only.

syntaxes.returnDescription: created '''custom channel ID''' (used in customChat command), 0 if failed. (see BIS_fnc_channelNumToRadioChannelID, BIS_fnc_radioChannelIDToChannelNum)

settriggerstatements.name: setTriggerStatements
settriggerstatements.description: Defines trigger condition, activation and deactivation statements. Trigger condition has to return Boolean. true will activate the trigger, false will deactivate it (only if activation is set to repeat). thisList returns the same result as list command, which includes all entities in the trigger area that are capable of activating the trigger. Dead entities are excluded as well as crew in vehicles, vehicles themselves are included.

scriptdone.name: scriptDone
scriptdone.description: Check if a script is finished running using the Script_(Handle) returned by execVM or spawn.

rightParam.name: handle
rightParam.description: handle returned by spawn or execVM

params.name: handle
params.description: handle returned by spawn or execVM

campreparefov.name: camPrepareFov
campreparefov.description: Prepares the camera field of view (zoom). The default zoom level is 0.75, 0.01 is the nearest and 2 the furthest zoom value. The angle of the field of view is atan(FOV)*2 radians when in 4:3 aspect ratio. Needs the call of camCommitPrepared to be conducted.

setwaypointdescription.name: setWaypointDescription
setwaypointdescription.description: Sets the description shown in the HUD while the waypoint is active.

triggerattachobject.name: triggerAttachObject
triggerattachobject.description: Assigns a static object to the trigger. The activation source is changed to "STATIC".

syntaxes.returnDescription: text value

cameraon.name: cameraOn

movetocompleted.name: moveToCompleted
movetocompleted.description: Check if latest low level moveTo command is finished.

typename.name: typeName
