ctrlsetstructuredtext.name: ctrlSetStructuredText
ctrlsetstructuredtext.description: Set the structured text which will be displayed in structured text control.

setdate.name: setDate
setdate.description: Sets the actual mission date and time. This command is JIP compatible. Players joining after mission start will get current server date set up.

airportside.name: airportSide
airportside.description: Checks a side of the airport. ID is the number to identify which airport on the island you want to check. Possible values for sara are:

initambientlife.name: initAmbientLife
initambientlife.description: Initialises the ambient life on local client from CfgWorlds >> worldName >> AmbientA3. Has no effect on dedicated server or headless client.

seteffectcondition.name: setEffectCondition
seteffectcondition.description: The statement is executed when the trigger or waypoint is activated and the effects are launched depending on the result.

from.name: from
from.description: Continue sequence of for var construct. It sets the start value of the index variable.

setvectordirandup.name: setVectorDirAndUp
setvectordirandup.description: Sets orientation of an object. The command takes 2 vector arrays, one for vectorDir and one for vectorUp. Default object orientation will always have vectorDir pointing forward (North) along Y axis and vectorUp pointing up along Z axis - [[0,1,0],[0,0,1]], as shown on the diagram below.
setvectordirandup.example: // set exact yaw, pitch, and roll _y = 45; _p = -80; _r = 0; BRICK setVectorDirAndUp [ [ sin _y * cos _p,cos _y * cos _p,sin _p], [ [ sin _r,-sin _p,cos _r * cos _p],-_y] call BIS_fnc_rotateVector2D ];

setvehicleinit.name: setVehicleInit
setvehicleinit.description: Attach a statement to a unit. The statement is propagated over the network in MP games, it can be executed by invoking processInitCommands.

setwaypointtimeout.name: setWaypointTimeout
setwaypointtimeout.description: Defines the time between condition satisfaction and waypoint finish (randomly from min to max, with an average value mid).

lightattachobject.name: lightAttachObject
lightattachobject.description: Attach light to given object at given position on object.

enableenvironment.name: enableEnvironment
enableenvironment.description: Enable/disable environmental effects: ambient life and/or ambient sound.

rightParam.name: enable
rightParam.description: false to disable ambient life and ambient sounds, true to re-enable it

params.name: enable
params.description: false to disable ambient life and ambient sounds, true to re-enable it

params.name: ambientLife
params.description: enable/disable ambient life (bees, rabbits, birds, snakes, fish)

ctrlmapanimdone.name: ctrlMapAnimDone
ctrlmapanimdone.description: Checks whether the map animation has finished.

setwaypointstatements.name: setWaypointStatements
setwaypointstatements.description: The waypoint is done only when the condition is fulfilled. When the waypoint is done, the statement expression is executed.

rectangular.name: rectangular
rectangular.description: Checks if a location is rectangular (returns true) or elliptical (returns false).

setplayable.name: setPlayable
setplayable.description: Create MP role for the unit. The roles created this way are used for Join In Progress and Team Switch. NOTE: Currently in Arma 3 this command does nothing.

switchableunits.name: switchableUnits
switchableunits.description: Returns a list of playable units available for switching to. Command is relative to the client on which it is executed and will only show playable units for the same side as player's group + player himself. The playableUnits command on the other hand will show all playable units regardless of the side. Exception is SP, where playable units from all sides will be accessible via this command. Dead units are automatically removed from the resulting array. Playable units that are already occupied by other human players will also not show in the results.

ctrlcommitted.name: ctrlCommitted
ctrlcommitted.description: Check if the control animation is finished.

setmarkersizelocal.name: setMarkerSizeLocal
setmarkersizelocal.description: Set marker size. Size is in format [a-axis, b-axis].

ctrlcommit.description: Commits control animation to last specified duration.
ctrlcommit.example: _control ctrlCommit 2; // make animation last approx. 2 seconds

displayctrl.name: displayCtrl

iskindof.name: isKindOf
iskindof.description: Checks whether the object is (a subtype) of the given type. While main syntax and alt syntax support only CfgVehicles, CfgAmmo and CfgNonAIVehicles, alt syntax 2 allows to specify any config, including mission config.

scopename.name: scopeName
scopename.description: Defines name of current scope. Name is visible in debugger, and name is also used as reference in some commands like breakOut and breakTo. Scope name should be defined only once per scope. Trying to set a different name on the scope that has already defined scope name will result in error.
scopename.example: scopeName "main"; while {true} do { scopeName "loop1"; while {true} do { scopeName "loop2"; ... }; };

htmlload.name: htmlLoad
htmlload.description: Load HTML-Files from file or Uri using given control. File path is relative to current mission dir or an absolute path (with drive letter etc.). The command is subject to restrictions, imposed by CfgCommands class.

rightParam.name: filename
rightParam.description: local file name or remote file URL

params.name: filename
params.description: local file name or remote file URL

text.name: text
text.description: Creates a structured text containing the given plain text if argument is String or returns location's text value if argument is Location (see Alt Syntax)

campreparefovrange.name: camPrepareFovRange
campreparefovrange.description: Prepares the camera field of view range for auto zooming.

ctrlshown.name: ctrlShown
ctrlshown.description: Returns whether given control is shown.

setvehiclevarname.name: setVehicleVarName
setvehiclevarname.description: Sets string representation of an object to a custom string. For example it is possible to return "MyFerrari" instead of default "ce06b00# 164274: offroad_01_unarmed_f.p3d" when querying object as string: hint str _offroad; //MyFerrari When a vehicle is created and named in the editor, the name becomes both the variable containing the vehicle object and the string representation of the vehicle object. vehicleVarName on the other hand is only string representation of the object. So if you want to refer to the actual object by its vehicleVarName, an extra step needed to assign the object to a variable of the same name. For example to see and refer to offroad as myFerrari: _offroad setVehicleVarName "MyFerrari"; MyFerrari = _offroad; In multiplayer environment setVehicleVarName has to be executed on every PC if you want the custom name to be known everywhere. If vehicle is created and named in the editor, the vehicle name will be known globally automatically.

ishidden.name: isHidden
ishidden.description: Return whether the person is hidden (reached the hiding position). For command that tests general visibility of an object use isObjectHidden

createtrigger.name: createTrigger
createtrigger.description: Creates a sensor (trigger) of the given type and at the given position. The type must be a class name in CfgNonAIVehicles or CfgVehicles with simulation = detector. An array containing all units that have activated the trigger is available via list triggerobj. Created triggers can be deleted using deleteVehicle.
createtrigger.example: _trg = createTrigger ["EmptyDetector", getPos player]; _trg setTriggerArea [5, 5, 0, false]; _trg setTriggerActivation ["CIV", "PRESENT", true]; _trg setTriggerStatements ["this", "hint 'Civilian near player'", "hint 'no civilian near'"];

syntaxes.returnDescription: created trigger

deletegroup.name: deleteGroup
deletegroup.description: Destroys the given group. Group must be empty and local to the machine executing command.

clearradio.name: clearRadio
clearradio.description: Clean up the content of radio protocol history.

settargetage.name: setTargetAge
settargetage.description: Sets how the target is known to the other centers. They behave like the target was seen age seconds ago. Possible age values are: "ACTUAL", "5 MIN", "10 MIN", "15 MIN", "30 MIN", "60 MIN", "120 MIN" or "UNKNOWN".

ctrlsettooltipcolorbox.name: ctrlSetTooltipColorBox
ctrlsettooltipcolorbox.description: Sets tooltip border color of given control. Color is in format Color.

ctrlsetfonth5.name: ctrlSetFontH5
ctrlsetfonth5.description: Sets H5 font of given HTML control.

setunitability.name: setUnitAbility
setunitability.description: Sets skill of given unit. Unlike setSkill, setUnitAbility can set values > 1. Even though the skill command will correctly return set value, the actual unit ability will be capped to max available.

parsetext.name: parseText
parsetext.description: Creates a structured text by parsing the given XML description. Do not use parseText when displaying a localized text from stringtable.xml (see notes below).

ctrlsetfonth1.name: ctrlSetFontH1
ctrlsetfonth1.description: Sets H1 font of given HTML control.

settriggeractivation.name: setTriggerActivation
settriggeractivation.description: Defines the trigger activation type. See ArmA:Mission Editor - Triggers for a thorough overview of triggers and its fields for activation, effects, etc. Since Arma 3 v1.67, "ANYPLAYER" activation can be used to detect any player.

currentcommand.name: currentCommand
currentcommand.description: Return the current command type (empty string when no command) for the commander of given vehicle (or for a given soldier). Returned value can be one of:

neartargets.name: nearTargets
neartargets.description: Returns a list of targets within the defined range. "Targets" are not restricted to enemy units.
neartargets.example: player nearTargets 100;could return something like this:

createdisplay.name: createDisplay
createdisplay.description: Creates child display of given display and loads from "resourceName". The notable difference between createDisplay and createDialog is that with createDisplay the player would be able to move whilst having control of the mouse pointer.

rightParam.name: resourceName
rightParam.description: custom display class defined in description.ext or existing display class from main config

params.name: resourceName
params.description: custom display class defined in description.ext or existing display class from main config

syntaxes.returnDescription: Created display (or displayNull if failed).

throw.name: throw
throw.description: Throws an exception. The exception is processed by first catch block. This command will terminate further execution of the code.

rightParam.name: exception
rightParam.description: value that is put into the `_exception` variable inside catch block

params.name: exception
params.description: value that is put into the `_exception` variable inside catch block

leftParam.description: if the condition returns true, ''exception'' is thrown

rightParam.description: value that is put into the `_exception` variable inside catch block

params.description: if the condition returns true, ''exception'' is thrown

params.description: value that is put into the `_exception` variable inside catch block

hidebehindscripted.name: hideBehindScripted
hidebehindscripted.description: When set to true it disables the default engine hiding behavior.

setwaypointscript.name: setWaypointScript
setwaypointscript.description: Attaches a script to a scripted waypoint. In early versions of Arma, command consisted of a script name and additional script arguments and the script had to use SQS-Syntax. The script receives the following arguments in _this variable: [group, position, target] + [the optional passed arguments]. The optional arguments are appended to the end of the return array.

step.name: step
step.description: Optionally can set step. If you want to count down, step must be specified, and set negative. Default value is 1.

finddisplay.name: findDisplay
finddisplay.description: Find display by its IDD (which is defined in the description.ext or config).

createsoundsource.name: createSoundSource
createsoundsource.description: Creates a sound source of the given type (type is the name of the subclass of CfgVehicles which is pointing to the sound defined in CfgSFX). The actual sound object created is of type "#dynamicsound" and could be detected with allMissionObjects. If the markers array contains several marker names, the position of a random one is used, otherwise, the given position is used. The sound source is placed inside a circle with this position as its center and placement as its radius. Some of the vanilla classes pre-configured in Arma 3:

params.name: markers
params.description:
if the markers array contains any markers, the position is randomly picked from array of given markers plus desired placement position.
If any of the markers were given a Z coordinate with setMarkerPos, the sound will also be created at the given Z coordinate

params.name: placement
params.description: the sound is placed inside a circle with given position as center and placement as its radius

syntaxes.returnDescription:
horizontal distance in meters
* y: Number - vertical distance in meters

campreloaded.name: camPreloaded
campreloaded.description: Checks whether the camera has finished preloading.

sendsimplecommand.name: sendSimpleCommand
sendsimplecommand.description: Sends a simple command to the vehicle's driver / gunner. The player executing command should be in the vehicle.

rain.name: rain
rain.description: Returns the current value of rain density in range 1...0

vectordir.name: vectorDir
vectordir.description: Return object's normalized direction vector in world space ([x,y,z]).

findnearestenemy.name: findNearestEnemy
findnearestenemy.description: Finds the nearest enemy to the specified position. Returns a null object if the object's group does not know about any enemies. This command will return nearest object that is known to the unit and is considered enemy. An empty vehicle that is part of enemy group assets (see addVehicle) can be returned as valid nearest target.

boundingbox.name: boundingBox
boundingbox.description: Returns a bounding box of given object in model coordinate space. This command is rather generous on the size estimation, for more precise coordinates use boundingBoxReal

syntaxes.returnDescription:
an array with the extreme points of the model, as well as bounding box sphere diameter.
Format [[xmin, ymin, zmin], [xmax, ymax, zmax], boundingSphereDiameter].

an array with the extreme points of the model bounding box, as well as bounding box sphere diameter.
Format [[xmin, ymin, zmin], [xmax, ymax, zmax], boundingSphereDiameter].

finite.name: finite
finite.description: True, if number is finite (not infinite and a valid number)

dogetout.name: doGetOut
dogetout.description: Orders a unit or units to get out from the vehicle (silently).

synchronizewaypoint trigger.name: synchronizeWaypoint trigger
synchronizewaypoint trigger.description: Synchronizes a trigger with other waypoints. Each waypoint is given as an array [group, index].

exportlandscapexyz.name: exportLandscapeXYZ
exportlandscapexyz.description: Exports landscape as XYZ file. Note: Not available in Retail Version

waypointattachobject.name: waypointAttachObject
waypointattachobject.description: Attaches a static object via it's numeric ID to the given waypoint.

setmarkerbrush.name: setMarkerBrush
setmarkerbrush.description: Selects the fill texture for the marker ("RECTANGLE" or "ELLIPSE"). Brush is the name of the subclass in CfgMarkerBrushes.

ctrlsetfonth2b.name: ctrlSetFontH2B
ctrlsetfonth2b.description: Sets H2 bold font of given HTML control.

activatekey.name: activateKey
activatekey.description: Activates the given keyname for the current user profile. The keys are used to unlock missions or campaigns. See keys, keysLimit and doneKeys in the description.ext file of the missions.

nextweatherchange.name: nextWeatherChange
nextweatherchange.description: Return the remaining time (in seconds) over which the current weather change will occur.

setwaypointhouseposition.name: setWaypointHousePosition
setwaypointhouseposition.description: For waypoints attached to a house, this defines the target buildingPos index.

ctrlsetfontheight.name: ctrlSetFontHeight
ctrlsetfontheight.description: Sets the sizeEx property for most controls but not all. CT_STRUCTURED_TEXT unfortunately is not supported as it operates on size property among other things. This setter command does not have a getter counterpart either.

setunitposweak.name: setUnitPosWeak
setunitposweak.description: Set unit position rules. Mode may be one of:

dofsm.name: doFSM
dofsm.description: Orders a unit to process command defined by FSM file (silently). Unlike with execFSM where _this is passed to the FSM, the following parameters are passed when using doFSM/commandFSM:

lbselection.name: lbSelection
lbselection.description: Returns Array of selected rows indices in the given listbox of style LB_MULTI (multi-selection). For single selection listbox use lbCurSel instead.

date.name: date
date.description: Return the actual in-mission date and time in format [year, month, day, hour, minute]. In MP the date is automatically and periodically synced with the server date.

campreparerelpos.name: camPrepareRelPos
campreparerelpos.description: Prepares the camera position relative to the current position of the currect target (see camPrepareTarget).

preloadtitleobj.name: preloadTitleObj
preloadtitleobj.description: Object title - Preload data the object can be defined in the Description.ext file.

modeltoworld.name: modelToWorld
modeltoworld.description: Translates relative position from object model space into world position.

rightParam.name: position
rightParam.description: [x,y,z] offset relative to the model centre

params.name: position
params.description: [x,y,z] offset relative to the model centre

syntaxes.returnDescription: translated world position

setwaypointcombatmode.name: setWaypointCombatMode
setwaypointcombatmode.description: The group combat mode is switched when the waypoint becomes active.

movetarget.name: moveTarget
movetarget.description: Change information about a target. Not yet implemented.

floor.name: floor
floor.description: Returns the next lowest integer in relation to x.

sethidebehind.name: setHideBehind
sethidebehind.description: Sets the data for hiding. objectWhereHide can be taken using findCover. hidePosition can be taken using getHideFrom. Command is not functional in ArmA 2.

ctrlactivate.name: ctrlActivate
ctrlactivate.description: Launch actions attached to given (button based) control.

leftParam.name: control
leftParam.description: button based control (CT_BUTTON, CT_XBUTTON, CT_SHORTCUTBUTTON, CT_ACTIVETEXT)

rightParam.name: full
rightParam.description: true to simulate button click in full including UI event handling

params.name: control
params.description: button based control (CT_BUTTON, CT_XBUTTON, CT_SHORTCUTBUTTON, CT_ACTIVETEXT)

params.name: full
params.description: true to simulate button click in full including UI event handling

setmarkertext.name: setMarkerText
setmarkertext.description: Sets the text label of an existing marker.

waypointattachvehicle.name: waypointAttachVehicle
waypointattachvehicle.description: Attaches a vehicle Object to the given Waypoint.

activateaddons.name: activateAddons
activateaddons.description: Activates the listed addons. The list of active addons is initialized during this function.

weapondirection.name: weaponDirection
weapondirection.description: Returns the direction that the vehicle weapon is aiming in. For addons the weapon name must be an entry in CfgWeapons. Returns an array in format [x, y, z]

preloadcamera.name: preloadCamera
preloadcamera.description: Preload all textures and models around given Position to avoid visual artifacts after camera is moved. Should be used before any abrupt camera change/cut. Returns true once all data is ready.

hierarchyobjectscount.name: hierarchyObjectsCount
hierarchyobjectscount.description: The number of objects in hierarchy.

setdropinterval.name: setDropInterval
setdropinterval.description: Set interval of emitting particles from particle source. In Arma 3 hardcoded limit of how many particles can exist at the same time is 18000. Correspondence between CfgCloudlets class param name and command param: particleSource setDropInterval interval;

addpublicvariableeventhandler.name: addPublicVariableEventHandler
addpublicvariableeventhandler.description: This event handler will detect if a missionNamespace variable (it is attached to) has been broadcast over network with publicVariable, publicVariableClient or publicVariableServer commands and will execute EH code upon detection. Arguments passed to the code in _this array are:
addpublicvariableeventhandler.example: "publicThis" addPublicVariableEventHandler { hint format [ "%1 has been updated to:Â %2", _this select 0, _this select 1 ] };

leftParam.name: varName
leftParam.description: name of the variable set on target with setVariable

params.name: varName
params.description: name of the variable set on target with setVariable

addvehicle.name: addVehicle
addvehicle.description: Adds a specified vehicle for use by a specified AI led group taking into account vehicle's cost. The vehicle will be considered as an available vehicle for use by this group. When vehicle is added in this way, it can appear as a target for the enemy even if the vehicle is currently free of the crew. Vehicles with crew, which are placed in the editor, get automatically added to the group. To remove vehicle from a group, use leaveVehicle.

posscreentoworld.name: posScreenToWorld
posscreentoworld.description: Convert screen coordinates in map to world coordinates.

moveto.name: moveTo
moveto.description: Low level command to person to move to given position.

settype.name: setType
settype.description: Changes a location to the specified class. Location classes are defined in CfgLocationTypes.

configfile.name: configFile
configfile.description: Return root of config entries hierarchy.

getposasl.name: getPosASL
getposasl.description: Returns the object position height above sea level.

distributionregion.name: distributionRegion
distributionregion.description: Returns the numerical index for the distribution region of this copy of ArmA. 1 - US 2 - Rest of the world

inheritsfrom.name: inheritsFrom
inheritsfrom.description: Returns base entry of config entry.
inheritsfrom.example: _base = inheritsFrom (configFile >> "CfgVehicles" >> "Car"); Result is Config entry for class "LandVehicle"

setposition.name: setPosition
setposition.description: Sets the position of a location.

nearestobjects.name: nearestObjects
nearestobjects.description: Returns a list of nearest objects of the given types to the given position or object, within the specified distance. If more than one object is found they will be ordered by proximity, the closest one will be first in the array. Alternatively, you use nearObjects command, which doesn't sort results.

params.name: position
params.description: where to find objects, center position.

params.name: types
params.description: list of class name of the objects to search for. Use an empty array `[]` to search for all classes.

params.name: radius
params.description: range from center position to search for objects.

params.name: 2Dmode
params.description: true for 2D distance, false for 3D distance

ctrlsetfontheighth5.name: ctrlSetFontHeightH5
ctrlsetfontheighth5.description: Sets H5 font size of given HTML control.

ctrltype.name: ctrlType
ctrltype.description: Returns number representing the type of control, which is also defined by type property in config. For more information see Dialog Control

radiovolume.name: radioVolume
radiovolume.description: Checks the current radio volume (set by fadeRadio).

onplayerconnected.name: onPlayerConnected
onplayerconnected.description: This command will execute attached code whenever a player is connected to a MP session. The code will receive a number of special variables:

setdirection.name: setDirection
setdirection.description: Set's the orientation of a location. It's area and map icon (if it's type uses an icon) will be rotated to this orientation.
setdirection.example: location1 = createLocation ["VegetationPalm", getPos player, 200, 200]; location1 setText "Benargee's Palm Tree"; location1 setDirection 45;

ctrlmapanimcommit.name: ctrlMapAnimCommit
ctrlmapanimcommit.example: Center map on player: _ctrl ctrlMapAnimAdd [0, 0.05, player]; ctrlMapAnimCommit _ctrl;

ctrlsetfontheighth6.name: ctrlSetFontHeightH6
ctrlsetfontheighth6.description: Sets H6 font size of given HTML control.

worldtomodel.name: worldToModel
worldtomodel.description: Converts position from world space to object model space.

syntaxes.returnDescription: position relative to model

nearestlocations.name: nearestLocations
nearestlocations.description: Returns an array of locations of chosen type(s) within the given radius of the given position, sorted from nearest to farthest.

params.name: locationTypes
params.description: list of location type names, e.g "NameCity"; {{GVI|arma3|2.14|size= 0.75}} passing empty array [] will return all available locations within the radius

params.name: radius
params.description: maximum distance from the given position that returned locations may be, in metres

params.name: sortPosition
params.description: results will be sorted from the distance to given ''sortPosition'' (nearest to farthest still)

deletecenter.name: deleteCenter
deletecenter.description: In a nutshell, this command removes gaming Side (see createCenter). If a side has >0 Groups it cannot be deleted. Center can only be created for: east, west, resistance, civilian and sideLogic, therefore only centers from the mentioned sides can be deleted.

setmarkerdir.name: setMarkerDir
setmarkerdir.description: Sets the orientation of the marker. Angle is in degrees.

ctrlsettooltip.name: ctrlSetTooltip
ctrlsettooltip.description: Sets tooltip text of given control.

leftParam.name: control
leftParam.description: any control type, (except for CT_STATIC & CT_STRUCTURED_TEXT, although Arma 3 now supports these too)

params.description: any control type, (except for CT_STATIC & CT_STRUCTURED_TEXT, although Arma 3 now supports these too)

onplayerdisconnected.name: onPlayerDisconnected
onplayerdisconnected.description: This command will execute attached code whenever a player is leaving an MP session. The code will receive a number of special variables:

campreparetarget.name: camPrepareTarget
campreparetarget.description: Prepares the camera target to a position or to a target.

tolower.name: toLower
tolower.description: Converts the supplied string to all lowercase characters.

toupper.name: toUpper
toupper.description: Converts the supplied string to all uppercase characters.

precision.name: precision
precision.description: Return the precision of the given entity, how is the entity able to be precise when moving to given target.
precision.example: if (position _this distance _dangerPos <= precision _this) then {...}; //used in formationCDanger.fsm

syntaxes.returnDescription: accuracy in metres

ctrlsetfonth1b.name: ctrlSetFontH1B
ctrlsetfonth1b.description: Sets H1 bold font of given HTML control.

waituntil.name: waitUntil
waituntil.description: Suspends execution of function or SQF based script until given condition is satisfied. This command will loop and call the code inside {} mostly every frame (depends on complexity of condition and overall engine load) until the code returns true. The execution of the rest of the script therefore will be suspended until waitUntil completes.

rightParam.name: condition
rightParam.description: the expression that '''must''' return a Boolean, true to finish waiting or false to continue waiting

params.name: condition
params.description: the expression that '''must''' return a Boolean, true to finish waiting or false to continue waiting

syntaxes.returnDescription: the value the condition evaluates to when the wait is over (normally true)

params.name: condition
params.description: the expression that '''must''' return a Boolean, true to finish waiting or false to continue waiting

params.name: timeout
params.description: a timeout in seconds of game time (sleep vs uiSleep). The timeout is only checked after the condition was checked. '''Any negative value disables the timeout'''

params.name: interval
params.description: the time interval in seconds of game time between condition checks, this is equivalent to using a "sleep" after the condition.

syntaxes.returnDescription: the value the condition evaluates to when the wait is over (normally true), or Nothing if the timeout ended the wait

assignedvehiclerole.name: assignedVehicleRole
assignedvehiclerole.description: Return the role a unit is assigned to within its assigned vehicle. The array which is returned contains:

ctrlsetfontheighth2.name: ctrlSetFontHeightH2
ctrlsetfontheighth2.description: Sets H2 font size of given HTML control.

ctrlsetfonth6.name: ctrlSetFontH6
ctrlsetfonth6.description: Sets H6 font of given HTML control.

runinitscript.name: runInitScript
runinitscript.description: Fades in mission screen and re-executes init.sqf and init.sqs scripts. In Eden Editor the code inside the "Init" mission attribute is executed.

ishidebehindscripted.name: isHideBehindScripted
ishidebehindscripted.description: Return whether the vehicle has set the hideBehindScripted to true or not.

rightParam.name: FSMHandle
rightParam.description: The FSM script must be launched with 'allowTermination' flag for this command to work (see execFSM).

params.name: FSMHandle
params.description: The FSM script must be launched with 'allowTermination' flag for this command to work (see execFSM).

rightParam.description: The result to write into the Promise

params.description: Only "Empty Handle"'s can have their result set.

params.name: result
params.description: The result to write into the Promise

setparticlecircle.name: setParticleCircle
setparticlecircle.description: Updates particle source, creates particles in circle with given radius. Velocity is transformed and added to total velocity. Correspondence between CfgCloudlets class param names and command array of params: particleSource setParticleCircle [ circleRadius, circleVelocity ];

params.name: circleRadius
params.description: the radius (x,y plain) in which particles are generated

params.name: circleVelocity
params.description: direction and speed of particles movement

params.name: ignoreSurfaces
params.description: true to calculate particle position relative to the source position. Default: false

ctrlsetforegroundcolor.name: ctrlSetForegroundColor
ctrlsetforegroundcolor.description: Sets foreground color of given control. Color is in format Color.

lbisselected.name: lbIsSelected
lbisselected.description: Check whether given row of the given listbox is selected.

settriggerarea.name: setTriggerArea
settriggerarea.syntax: trigger setTriggerArea [a, b, angle, isRectangle, c]
settriggerarea.description: Defines the area monitored by the given trigger. The area could be either rectangular or elliptical. Since Arma 3 v1.59.135137 it is possible to define 3 dimensional area to monitor by specifying extra param for the area height (see pic).

params.name: a
params.description: trigger area X size / 2, in meters

params.name: b
params.description: trigger area Y size / 2, in meters

params.name: c
params.description: trigger area Z size / 2, in meters. -1 for infinite height

syntaxes.signature: trigger setTriggerArea [a, b, angle, isRectangle, c]

setmusiceffect.name: setMusicEffect
setmusiceffect.description: Defines the music track played on activation. Track is a subclass name of CfgMusic. In addition, "$STOP$" (stops the current music track).

camerainterest.name: cameraInterest
camerainterest.description: Return camera interest for given entity, as set by setCameraInterest, or as autodetected.

locationposition.name: locationPosition
locationposition.description: Returns the position of a location. If the location is attached to an object, that object's position is returned.

syntaxes.returnDescription: as locations are placed at Z = zero ASL the returned Z is negative on land and around zero on water, see #Example 3

reloadenabled.name: reloadEnabled
reloadenabled.description: Check whether magazine is reloaded whenever emptied.

setcurrentwaypoint.name: setCurrentWaypoint
setcurrentwaypoint.description: Sets the currently active waypoint for a group.

ctrlsetfonth3.name: ctrlSetFontH3
ctrlsetfonth3.description: Sets H3 font of given HTML control.

actionkeysnames.name: actionKeysNames
actionkeysnames.description: Returns a list of button names assigned to the given user action. You can find the action names in config class ControllerSchemes or user action names.

params.name: maxKeys
params.description: maximum number of keys to return

isnil.name: isNil
isnil.description: Tests whether the variable defined by the String argument is undefined, or whether an expression result passed as Code is undefined.

syntaxes.returnDescription: true if variable is nil or undefined
true if ''code'' returns Nothing, false otherwise
true if variable is nil or undefined

forcespeed.name: forceSpeed
forcespeed.description: Force the speed limit on given object (object will never attempt to move faster than given by forceSpeed). Use negative value to return to default behaviour. Used unit is m/s.

deletecollection.name: deleteCollection
deletecollection.description: Delete a collection. As example, used with a soldier, it'll hide the ingame model. When targetting ArmA 2 1.06 or newer, use hideObject instead. This function is a relic from dynamic building destruction development. It is left only for compatibility with scripts created before ArmA 2 1.06, and its functionality may be changed or removed in the future.

fog.name: fog
fog.description: A getter for setFog. Returns the current value of the fog in range 0...1.

nearestlocation.name: nearestLocation
nearestlocation.description: Return the closest location of specified class to a given position.

params.description: max search radius. Default - unlimited range.

displayseteventhandler.name: displaySetEventHandler
displayseteventhandler.description: Sets given event handler of given display. The return code of the provided function should indicate whether this event was handled correctly. This implies telling the engine whether it's default code should be executed. See User Interface Event Handlers for the full list of handler names. If applicable, see DIK_KeyCodes for a list of key code constants, which are relevant to key related user interface events like: KeyDown & KeyUp.

breakout.name: breakOut
breakout.description: Breaks the code execution out of scope {} named name. nil is returned. Scope name can be assigned using scopeName command.
breakout.example: scopeName "main"; while {true} do { scopeName "loop1"; while {true} do { scopeName "loop2"; if (condition1) then {breakTo "main"}; // Breaks all scopes and return to "main" if (condition2) then {breakOut "loop2"}; // Breaks scope named "loop2" sleep 1; }; sleep 1; };

rightParam.description: name of the scope which was previously set with scopeName. `""` will exit the current scope (see also exitWith)

ctrlsettooltipcolortext.description: Sets tooltip text color of given control. Color is in format Color.

landat.name: landAt
landat.description: Order an AI airplane to land at a given airport. ID is the number to identify which map airport you want the airplane to land at. Since Arma 3 v1.68 it is possible to also make the airplane land at a dynamic airport object (e.g. aircraft carrier, makeshift runway...).

params.description: (Helicopter type only) time to wait after touch down in "GetIn"/"GetOut" mode before taking off to the next waypoint. Default: -1.

params.description: when true, the given land position will be adjusted to the nearest surface underneath. Default: false.

one of the following: "None", "Land", "GetIn", "GetOut" or "".
* landResult: String - one of the following: "Found", "NotFound", "NotReady" or "".

* waitTime: Number - (Helicopter type only) before heli is landed - wait time set for "GetIn"/"GetOut" mode, after heli is landed - remaining time before take off to the next waypoint or -1.
* autopilotState: String - one of the following: "FAR", "BRAKE", "NEAR", "ALIGN", "REACHED", "LOITER", "FOLLOW" or "".

setvehicleposition.name: setVehiclePosition
setvehicleposition.description: Moves the object to a given position (same as createVehicle placement algorithm). Uses either the position that's defined by the position param, or one of the marker positions from the markers array. The object is placed inside a circle with position as its center and placement as its radius. The type of placement could also be controlled with special.
setvehicleposition.example: player setVehiclePosition [[1000,2000], ["Pos1","Pos2","Pos3"], 0, "CAN_COLLIDE"]; Will place the player at either [1000,2000], or one of the three markers positions.

params.description:
desired placement position.

if the markers array contains one or more marker names, the position is chosen randomly and could be one of the marker positions or just the supplied main position.
If marker had z coordinate set with setMarkerPos, the vehicle will be placed on the nearest surface below this z coordinate

setvectorup.description: Set object's up vector. Direction of the object remain unchanged. Default object's vectorUp is [0,0,1]. In Multiplayer, setVectorUp must be executed on the machine where the object it applied to is local.

glanceat.name: glanceAt
glanceat.description: Control what the unit is glancing at (target or Position). How frequently the unit is glancing there depends on behaviour.

respawnvehicle.name: respawnVehicle
respawnvehicle.syntax: vehicle respawnVehicle [respawnDelay, respawnCount, deleteOldWreck, respawnOnServer, respawnFlying, respawnUnit, respawnMode, respawnSide, useRespawnMarkerDir]
respawnvehicle.description: Sets vehicle as respawnable in MP game. The vehicle will be spawned at the locality and coordinates it was prior to destruction. If respawn type is set to base respawn (type 3) and vehicle respawn marker is provided (respawn_vehicle_XXXSIDEXXX), vehicle will spawn on the marker.
respawnvehicle.example: car respawnVehicle [5, 3]; 'car' will respawn at the predefined marker for the side after 5 seconds. The unit will respawn 3 times.

rightParam.name: [respawnDelay, respawnCount, deleteOldWreck, respawnOnServer, respawnFlying, respawnUnit, respawnMode, respawnSide, useRespawnMarkerDir]

params.name: respawnDelay
params.description: (Optional since 2.18, default -1) delay in seconds between respawns. (-1 to use 3DEN vehicle respawn delay or ''respawnVehicleDelay'' from description.ext)

params.name: respawnCount
params.description: how many times to respawn vehicle in total. (since 2.18 -1 unlimited respawns, 0 stop respawning)

params.name: deleteOldWreck
params.description: - deletes old wreck automatically after vehicle respawns

params.name: respawnOnServer
params.description: - wreck is always transferred to the server and the new vehicle always respawns on server

params.name: respawnFlying
params.description: - by default all vehicles placed on the ground, true overrides this

params.name: respawnUnit
params.description: - unit that would be put in the driver seat after vehicle respawns

params.name: respawnMode
params.description: - overrides vehicle respawn mode. Available modes are: 2 or "INSTANT" and 3 or "BASE". -1 use description.ext value.

params.name: respawnSide
params.description: - sets respawn side for the purpouse of selecting respawn marker

params.name: useRespawnMarkerDir
params.description: - respawn vehicle matches respawn marker direction or the old wreck direction. false - random direction.

syntaxes.signature: vehicle respawnVehicle [respawnDelay, respawnCount, deleteOldWreck, respawnOnServer, respawnFlying, respawnUnit, respawnMode, respawnSide, useRespawnMarkerDir]

ctrlsetfonth4b.name: ctrlSetFontH4B

processinitcommands.name: processInitCommands
processinitcommands.description: Process statements stored using setVehicleInit. The statements will only be executed once even if processInitCommands is called multiple times.

actionkeys.name: actionKeys
actionkeys.description: Returns Array containing dikCodes of keys, buttons and combos assigned to the given user action. Action names could be found in config class ControllerSchemes or user action names or user profile, for example:

setdestination.name: setDestination
setdestination.description: Set the destination for path planning of the pilot. Possible values for planningMode are:

params.name: forceReplan
params.description: specifies if replanning of the path should be forced.

position location.name: position location
position location.description: Returns a location's position. If it is attached to an object, the location's set or created position is returned rather than object's position.

keyname.name: keyName
keyname.description: Returns the name of a button (on the keyboard, mouse or joystick) with the given code.

ctrlsetbackgroundcolor.name: ctrlSetBackgroundColor
ctrlsetbackgroundcolor.description: Sets background color of given control.

cutfadeout.name: cutFadeOut
cutfadeout.description: Terminates the effect in the given layer by fading it out according to the given duration. If named layer used and it doesn't exist, it will be allocated.

leftParam.name: layerName
leftParam.description: effect layer name. Layer names are CaSe SeNsItIvE

params.name: layerName
params.description: effect layer name. Layer names are CaSe SeNsItIvE

gethidefrom.name: getHideFrom
gethidefrom.description: Returns the Position where object believes the enemy to be. If there is no direct line of sight between the object and the enemy, this position is extrapolated based on the last known position and speed of the enemy. A returned position of [0,0,0] implies that object does not knowAbout enemy. If enemy is null it is some position in front of the object or enemy position.

syntaxes.returnDescription: ASLToATL representation of the believed aimPos of the enemy object

setmarkershapelocal.name: setMarkerShapeLocal
setmarkershapelocal.description: Selects the shape (type) of the marker. Shape can be "ICON", "RECTANGLE" or "ELLIPSE".

setmarkerbrushlocal.name: setMarkerBrushLocal
setmarkerbrushlocal.description: Selects the fill texture for the marker ("RECTANGLE" or "ELLIPSE"). Brush is the name of the subclass in CfgMarkerBrushes.

createmarker.name: createMarker
createmarker.description: Creates a new marker at the given position. The marker name has to be unique. If position is given in 3D format, z coordinate is stored with the marker and will be used when marker is passed to commands like createVehicle, createUnit, createAgent, createMine, setVehiclePosition for example. However getMarkerPos and markerPos will always return 0 for z.

params.name: name
params.description: the marker's name, used to reference the marker in scripts.

params.name: position
params.description: In case of an object, the object's model [0,0,0] is used.

params.name: channel
params.description: the marker channel - see Channel IDs (for multiplayer)

syntaxes.returnDescription: the marker's name or empty string if the marker name is not unique.

actionkeysimages.name: actionKeysImages
actionkeysimages.description: Returns a list of button images or names assigned to the given user action. A maximum of maxKeys keys is listed. You can find the action names in config class ControllerSchemes or user action names.

ctrlsetfontheighth3.name: ctrlSetFontHeightH3
ctrlsetfontheighth3.description: Sets H3 font size of given HTML control.

creategroup.name: createGroup
creategroup.description: Creates a new Group for the given Side. An HQ (center) for that side must already be in the Mission.sqm or have been initialized with createCenter. For the available sides see Side.

syntaxes.returnDescription: grpNull if the group limit is reached
grpNull if the group limit is reached

ctrlsettooltipcolorshade.name: ctrlSetTooltipColorShade
ctrlsettooltipcolorshade.description: Sets tooltip background color of given control. Color is in format Color.

ctrlmapscale.name: ctrlMapScale
ctrlmapscale.description: Returns the current scale of given map control.

ctrlsetfonth5b.name: ctrlSetFontH5B
ctrlsetfonth5b.description: Sets H5 bold font of given HTML control.

limitspeed.name: limitSpeed
limitspeed.description: Limit speed of given vehicle or person to given value (in km/h).
limitspeed.example: // Adjust "speedLimit" variable to change limited speed. (A3 1.24 we don't need loop for a continus effect, limitSpeed alone is enough.) _this setVariable ["speedLimit", 200]; _nul = _this spawn { while {canMove _this} do { _this limitSpeed (_this getVariable "speedLimit"); sleep 0.1; }; };

rightParam.name: speed
rightParam.description: in km/h; By default, it's `2 * maxSpeed` of the vehicle/unit (which is defined in config). See Example 1.

params.name: speed
params.description: in km/h; By default, it's `2 * maxSpeed` of the vehicle/unit (which is defined in config). See Example 1.

moveinturret.name: moveInTurret
moveinturret.description: Moves the soldier into the vehicle's turret. (Immediately, without animation). turret path is an array of positions inside a turret, or positions inside a turret of a turret.

attachedobject.name: attachedObject
attachedobject.description: Returns the object a location is attached to. If the location is unattached, then objNull is returned.

sleep.name: sleep
sleep.description: Suspends code execution for given time in seconds. The sleep precision is given by a framerate, the delay given is the minimal delay expected. Must be called inside of a context which is interruptible, i.e. a script executed by execVM or spawn.

rightParam.name: delay
rightParam.description: in seconds. Negative values will not be considered.

params.name: delay
params.description: in seconds. Negative values will not be considered.

createmissiondisplay.name: createMissionDisplay
createmissiondisplay.description: Create single missions display as a child of given display. The mission dialog will be set to the directory given as an argument "root".

createunit array.name: createUnit array
createunit array.syntax: group createUnit [type, position, markers, placement, special]
createunit array.description: Creates a unit of class that's defined in CfgVehicles.

type.name: type
type.description: Returns a string of a location's class name.

syntaxes.returnDescription: the type of the task

createtarget.name: createTarget
createtarget.description: Create a target. Not yet implemented.

createguardedpoint.name: createGuardedPoint
createguardedpoint.description: Adds a point guarded by the given side (scripted way of adding equivalent of "GUARDED BY" trigger in Editor). A closest AI group in the given side with assigned "GUARD" waypoint will attempt to secure this guard point. The actual guarded position is determined via the following rules:

params.name: side
params.description: the side which will be guarding

params.name: objectMapID
params.description: static id of map object. -1 to ignore

params.name: vehicle
params.description: vehicle to be used for position. objNull to ignore

nearobjects.name: nearObjects
nearobjects.description: Find objects in a sphere with given radius. The first object in the returned array is not necessarily the closest one. If you need returned objects to be sorted by distance, use nearestObjects. If typeName is given, only objects of given type (or its subtype) are listed.

selectleader.name: selectLeader
selectleader.description: Select a group's leader. In MP the group has to be local to the PC executing the command. Locality of the group can be checked with local command and group ownership with groupOwner command.

playerside.name: playerSide
playerside.description: Returns the player's side. This is valid even when the player controlled person is dead (a difference from side player).
playerside.example: if (side man1 == playerSide) then { hint "man1 is on your side!"; };

ctrlsetposition.name: ctrlSetPosition
ctrlsetposition.description: Sets wanted position and size for 2D control animation. Width and height are optional. ctrlCommit is required to complete the operation. For 3D control, param is relative [x,y,z] and no ctrlCommit is required as it cannot be animated.

params.name: z
params.description: distance from the screen (depth). If object is too far, it cannot be dragged by the mouse.

drawellipse.name: drawEllipse
drawellipse.syntax: map drawEllipse [centre, a, b, angle, color, fill, alignWithMap]
drawellipse.description: Draws an ellipse on the map. Just like with marker or trigger area, negative a and b will result in hexagon.
drawellipse.example: findDisplay 12 displayCtrl 51 ctrlAddEventHandler ["Draw", { _this select 0 drawEllipse [ player, 10, 10, 0, [1, 0, 0, 1], "" ]; _this select 0 drawEllipse [ player, -10, -10, 0, [1, 1, 1, 1], "#(rgb,8,8,3)color(1,0.6,0,1)" ]; _this select 0 drawEllipse [ player, -10, -10, 90, [0, 0, 1, 1], "" ]; }];

rightParam.name: [centre, a, b, angle, color, fill, alignWithMap]

params.name: fill
params.description: fill texture file or Procedural Textures. Note that the file texture will not rotate with rectangle, use drawIcon for that. If fill texture is not empty, set line color to white [1,1,1,1]

params.name: alignWithMap
params.description: - when false the shape will not follow map rotation.

syntaxes.signature: map drawEllipse [centre, a, b, angle, color, fill, alignWithMap]

findcover.name: findCover
findcover.syntax: object findCover [position, hidePosition, maxDist, minDist, visibilityPosition, ignoreObject]
findcover.description: Returns the object around where the unit finds cover. The minDist, visibilityPosition and ignoreObject parameters are optional. Command is not functional since Arma 2.

params.name: hidePosition
params.description: getHideFrom-like position from which the unit should hide

params.name: visibilityPosition
params.description: used to select cover that unit can see in that direction from

params.name: ignoreObject
params.description: ignore this object in visibility check

syntaxes.returnDescription: always objNull
syntaxes.signature: object findCover [position, hidePosition, maxDist, minDist, visibilityPosition, ignoreObject]

titlefadeout.name: titleFadeOut
titlefadeout.description: Terminate the title effect and set duration of the fade out phase to the given time.

surfacetype.description: Returns what surface type is at the given position.

params.name: x
params.description: world x coordinate of the position

params.name: y
params.description: world y coordinate of the position

params.name: z or useLayerMask
params.description:
When a number is provided (Z in 3D positions), it is ignored. When a boolean is provided, it defines whether the layer mask should be used. Using the layer mask is more accurate but slightly slower.
thumb|256px|The patches of "dirt" are defined using a layer mask. The "concrete" is the primary surface texture.

syntaxes.returnDescription: Surface type

campaignconfigfile.name: campaignConfigFile
campaignconfigfile.description: Return root of campaign description.ext entries hierarchy.

syntaxes.returnDescription: one of `"Auto"`, `"Up"`, `"Middle"`, `"Down"` (as of {{arma3}})

istext.name: isText

sizeof.name: sizeOf
sizeof.description: Returns the diameter of bounding sphere of the object of given type in meters. Size returned is usually bigger than the biggest size of the object along any of the axes. For example if object is 10 x 4 x 5 the sizeOf value returned expected to be around 10. If you need to estimate the size of the object more precisely, use boundingBox or boundingBoxReal. NOTE: The object has to be present in current mission to be able to read its size (otherwise zero will be returned).

syntaxes.returnDescription: size returned is usually bigger than the biggest size of the object along any of the axes. For example if object is 10 x 4 x 5 the sizeOf value returned expected to be around 10.

ctrlsetfonth2.name: ctrlSetFontH2
ctrlsetfonth2.description: Sets H2 font of given HTML control

setvectordir.name: setVectorDir
setvectordir.description: Set object's direction vector. Up vector will remain unchanged.

preprocessfilelinenumbers.name: preprocessFileLineNumbers
preprocessfilelinenumbers.description: Returns the preprocessed content of the given file. The preprocessor is C-like, it supports comments using /* */ and PreProcessor_Commands. The preprocessor also adds a default debug entrypoint for compiler at the begining of script: #line 1 "aFilename"

syntaxes.returnDescription: file content containing `#line 1 "aFilename"`

setmarkertextlocal.name: setMarkerTextLocal
setmarkertextlocal.description: Sets the text label of an existing marker.

iskeyactive.name: isKeyActive
iskeyactive.description: Checks whether the given key is active in the current user profile. See keys, keysLimit and doneKeys in the description.ext file of the missions.

syntaxes.returnDescription: always returns false

fogforecast.name: fogForecast

removeswitchableunit.description: Remove a unit from the list of units available for Team Switch.

enableteamswitch.name: enableTeamSwitch
enableteamswitch.description: Enable / disable Team Switch. The default setting is enabled.

setmarkertypelocal.description: Set marker type. See cfgMarkers for a list of standard markers.

params.description: only passing Structured Text has any effect

preloadsound.name: preloadSound

worldname.name: worldName

assigntoairport.name: assignToAirport

linebreak.description: Creates a structured text containing a line break.

createcenter.name: createCenter
createcenter.description: In a nutshell, this command creates game Side. Without side it is not possible to create Groups. So if center for particular side is undefined, no groups can be created for this side. A Unit needs a group to be able to spawn in. So if no center for particular side exists, no groups for this side can be created and therefore no units for this side can be spawned. In Arma 3, the centers for all sides are created for you. An attempt to create center for existing side is ignored. Center can only be created for: east, west, resistance, civilian and sideLogic. These are the only sides groups can be created for.

closedisplay.name: closeDisplay
closedisplay.description: Close given display with exit code. Most common exit codes are: #define IDC_OK 1 //emulate "Ok" button #define IDC_CANCEL 2 //emulate "Cancel" button

commandfsm.name: commandFSM
commandfsm.description: Orders a unit to process command defined by FSM file (via the radio).

ctrlseteventhandler.name: ctrlSetEventHandler
ctrlseteventhandler.description: Sets given event handler of given control. The provided function should return true/false indicating that the event has handled this event fully or not and whether the engine should execute it's default code or not afterwards. See User Interface Event Handlers for the full list of handler names. If applicable, see DIK_KeyCodes for a list of key code constants, which are relevant to key related user interface events like: KeyDown & KeyUp.

params.name: function
params.description: should return a Boolean indicating that the event has handled this event fully or not and whether the engine should execute its default code or not afterwards

vehicles.name: vehicles

createmarkerlocal.name: createMarkerLocal
createmarkerlocal.description: Creates a local marker at the given position. Marker exists only on PC that created it. The marker name has to be unique. If position is given in 3D format, z coordinate is stored with the marker and will be used when marker is passed to commands like createVehicle, createUnit, createAgent, createMine, setVehiclePosition for example. However getMarkerPos and markerPos will always return 0 for z.

params.description: object's model centre is used (see getPosWorld)

syntaxes.returnDescription: the marker's name, or an empty string if the marker name is not unique

settitleeffect.name: setTitleEffect

formationposition.description: Return position of unit in the formation

ctrlsetfontp.name: ctrlSetFontP
ctrlsetfontp.description: Sets P font of given HTML control or its size.

setairportside.name: setAirportSide
setairportside.description: Set owning side of the airport. ID is the number to identify which airport on the island you want to check.

ctrlsetfonth4.name: ctrlSetFontH4
ctrlsetfonth4.description: Sets H4 font of given HTML control.

name of intersected selection

keyimage.name: keyImage

addswitchableunit.name: addSwitchableUnit
addswitchableunit.description: Adds a unit into the list of units available for Team Switch. Units marked as playable in editor are automatically switchable. This command allows to add non-playable unit into array of switchableUnits and make them available for teamSwitch. SP only.

setmarkercolorlocal.name: setMarkerColorLocal
setmarkercolorlocal.description: Sets marker color for the given marker locally. Marker color names and their corresponding RGBA values for Arma 3 could be found in here: CfgMarkerColors_Arma_3

formationleader.name: formationLeader

row index

bis_fnc_arraypop.description: This function removes the last (rightmost) element of an array and returns it.

uisleep.name: uiSleep
uisleep.description: Suspend execution of script for given uitime. uiSleep is a sleep method to delay script execution where script time/simulation time is stopped. uiSleep is basically using the system time (uiTime more specifically) and not simulation time. So in the cases where sleep command would get stuck indefinitely, uiSleep can still be used to effectively delay script execution. For example in a mission briefing or an editor or when simulation is paused in general.

lnbsize.name: lnbSize
lnbsize.description: Returns size of 2D listbox or combobox as [rows, columns].

shape of given marker. Can be return:

* `"RECTANGLE"`

findemptyposition.name: findEmptyPosition
findemptyposition.description: Searches for an empty position around specified position. The search starts looking for an empty position at a minimum distance of [minDistance] from the [center] and looks as far away as [maxDistance]. If a [vehicleType] parameter is specified, then the search will look for an empty positions that is big enough to hold that vehicle type. If an empty position isn't found, an empty array is returned.

leftParam.name: center
leftParam.description: search area center position in format [x,y] or [x,y,z] in which case z is ignored

params.name: center
params.description: search area center position in format [x,y] or [x,y,z] in which case z is ignored

params.name: maxDistance
params.description: stop searching no further than `areaRadius + maxDistance` from the center

params.name: vehicleType
params.description: classname of a vehicle to accommodate

syntaxes.returnDescription: a suitable empty position or empty array `[]` if not found

bis_fnc_arraypush.name: BIS_fnc_arrayPush
bis_fnc_arraypush.description: This function adds an element to the end of an array and returns the array.

bis_fnc_spawncrew.name: BIS_fnc_spawnCrew
bis_fnc_spawncrew.description: Function to fill all crew positions in a vehicle, including turrets. In dummy mode no objects are created and the returned array contains only ones. In this mode the function can be used to count the actual crew of an existing vehicle or vehicle type.

joinassilent.name: joinAsSilent
joinassilent.description: Joins the unit to the given group, if position id is available, this one is used. Avoid any radio communication related to joining.

clearmagazinecargoglobal.name: clearMagazineCargoGlobal
clearmagazinecargoglobal.description: Removes all magazines from the vehicle cargo space. MP synchronized.

hcremovegroup.description: Removes group from unit's high command bar.

numbertodate.name: numberToDate
numbertodate.description: Convert float number to a date.

params.description: year time in range 0..1, from beginning to end of the year (e.g `0` is January 1<sup>st</sup> and `1` is December 31<sup>st</sup>)

getobjectargument.name: getObjectArgument
getobjectargument.description: Return name of object argument in mission editor.
getobjectargument.example: // returns string "[1009.0351, 1319.4928]" (findDisplay 128 displayCtrl 51) getObjectArgument ["_unit_1", "POSITION"] // returns array [1009.0351, 1319.4928] (findDisplay 128 displayCtrl 51) evalObjectArgument ["_unit_1", "POSITION"]

bis_fnc_threat.name: BIS_fnc_threat
bis_fnc_threat.description: Calculates threat values of given unit.

mapcenteroncamera.name: mapCenterOnCamera
mapcenteroncamera.description: <control> mapCenterOnCamera <boolean> syntax enables/disables continuous centering of the main map type control on the camera position. Needs to be executed once.
mapcenteroncamera.example: //--- Minimap update ((uiNamespace getVariable "BIS_UAV_DISPLAY") displayCtrl 112410) mapCenterOnCamera true;

bis_fnc_scenesetbehaviour.name: BIS_fnc_sceneSetBehaviour
bis_fnc_scenesetbehaviour.description: Enables / disables a specific set of AI units, usable for cutscenes.

bis_fnc_sortnum.name: BIS_fnc_sortNum
bis_fnc_sortnum.description: Sorts an array of numbers from lowest (left) to highest (right). The passed array is modified by reference. This function uses the quick sort algorithm.

kbremovetopic.name: kbRemoveTopic
kbremovetopic.description: Unregister conversation topic from given person. See Conversations for more details.

createteam.name: createTeam
createteam.description: Create a team and name it.

bis_fnc_parsenumber.name: BIS_fnc_parseNumber
bis_fnc_parsenumber.example: _result = 7.62 call BIS_fnc_parseNumber; _result = "7.62" call BIS_fnc_parseNumber; _result = { 7.62 } call BIS_fnc_parseNumber;

setwaypointvisible.name: setWaypointVisible
setwaypointvisible.description: Sets the visibility of the waypoint.

bis_fnc_destroycity.name: BIS_fnc_destroyCity
bis_fnc_destroycity.description: Destroys building in given area based on input seed.

viewdistance.name: viewDistance

Note: while for ArmA 2 or ArmA 2: Operation Arrowhead until version 1.60 the result always contains a number, it should be always handled as an opaque string. Converting it to a Number can cause precision problems, as Number cannot accurately represent integers above 16777216 (2^24). lineintersectssurfaces.name: lineIntersectsSurfaces
lineintersectssurfaces.syntax: lineIntersectsSurfaces [begPosASL, endPosASL, ignoreObj1, ignoreObj2, sortMode, maxResults, LOD1, LOD2, returnUnique]
lineintersectssurfaces.description: Returns list of intersections with surfaces from begPosASL to endPosASL. If there is ground intersection, it is also included. Works on units. Works underwater. Doesn't return intersection with sea surface. Hardcoded max distance: 5000m. By default, for speed purposes, command will return only 1st intersection with unique objects. Since Arma 3 v1.69.140138, this could be tweaked with an optional param. NOTE: if begPosASL is under the ground and endPosASL is above it, the command will only return intersection with the ground, this is engine limitation and none of the intersectXXX commands will work when initiated from under the ground.
lineintersectssurfaces.example: _intersections = lineIntersectsSurfaces [eyePos player, aimPos chopper, player, chopper, true, -1];

rightParam.name: [begPosASL, endPosASL, ignoreObj1, ignoreObj2, sortMode, maxResults, LOD1, LOD2, returnUnique]

params.name: sortMode
params.description: true: closest to furthest, false: furthest to closest

params.name: maxResults
params.description: max results to return. -1 to return every result

params.name: LOD2
params.description: secondary LOD to look for intersection. See ''LOD1'' for possible values

params.name: returnUnique
params.description: when false, all intersections in the same object are included, otherwise only the first one

syntaxes.returnDescription:
the actual position where line intersects surface
* surfaceNormal: Vector - a normal to the intersected surface 
* intersectObject: Object - the object the surface belongs to (could be proxy object) - objNull if terrain
* parentObject: Object - the object proxy object belongs to (not always the same as intersect object) - objNull if terrain
* {{GVI|arma3|2.10|size= 0.75}} selectionNames: Array of Strings - Names of the intersected selections (bones). Returns `[]` if there is no intersection with a selection.
* {{GVI|arma3|2.10|size= 0.75}} pathToBisurf: String - path to intersected surface properties (.bisurf) file. Returns `""` if surface has no special properties. Terrain surface properties begin with `#`, and the surface properties are defined in `CfgSurfaces`. For example, if it returns `#GdtVRsurface01`, properties are defined in: `configFile >> "CfgSurfaces" >> "GdtVRsurface01"`
syntaxes.signature: lineIntersectsSurfaces [begPosASL, endPosASL, ignoreObj1, ignoreObj2, sortMode, maxResults, LOD1, LOD2, returnUnique]

playsound3d.name: playSound3D
playsound3d.syntax: playSound3D [filename, soundSource, isInside, soundPosition, volume, soundPitch, distance, offset, local, loop]
playsound3d.description: Plays positional sound with given filename on every computer on network. At least 2 parameters must be specified.

rightParam.name: [filename, soundSource, isInside, soundPosition, volume, soundPitch, distance, offset, local, loop]

params.name: filename
params.description:
see Arma 3: Sound Files for available file names or arma3|2.10|size= 0.75 the file name can start with a leading backslash `'''\'''a3\...`.
However a leading backslash must '''not''' be used for an '''addon''' sound file.

params.name: soundSource
params.description: the object emitting the sound. If ''soundPosition'' below is specified this parameter is ignored

params.name: isInside
params.description: - true to simulate a sound played inside a building or similar

params.name: soundPosition
params.description:
position for sound emitter, overrides ''soundSource''. Object is also supported (see note below). Since {{GVI|arma3|2.24|size= 0.75}} use nil to skip this param
If a following parameter has to be used, simply use `getPosASL _soundSource` for ''soundPosition'' instead of `_soundSource` for ''soundSource''.
This parameter also takes Object but their AGL position is used instead of ASL resulting in sound source being underground if they're above ground, always use PositionASL instead.

params.name: volume
params.description: sound volume. A value greater than 5 gets capped

params.name: distance
params.description: how far the sound is audible, in meters. `0` means no maximum distance

params.name: offset
params.description: offset in seconds. Same as with playMusic (ignored if sound is set to play repeatedly, see 'loop')

params.name: local
params.description: if true the sound will not be broadcast over network

params.name: loop
params.description: if true the sound will repeat indefinitely. In MP, requires 'local' to be set to true. Use stopSound to stop.

syntaxes.returnDescription: id of the sound (0..65535) (was Nothing before {{GVI|arma3|2.12|size= 0.75}})
syntaxes.signature: playSound3D [filename, soundSource, isInside, soundPosition, volume, soundPitch, distance, offset, local, loop]

bis_fnc_modulerespawnvehicle.name: BIS_fnc_moduleRespawnVehicle
bis_fnc_modulerespawnvehicle.description: Set vehicle respawn, compatible both with SP and MP. Parameter(s): 0: OBJECT - vehicle 1: NUMBER - respawn delay in seconds (default is 0) BOOL - true to remove vehicle respawn (further params are ignored), false to check if the vehicle is marked for respawn 2: NUMBER - how long until the vehicle is automatically respawned after its crew leaves it (default is -1, i.e., disabled) 3: NUMBER - number of time the vehicle can be respawned (default is -1, i.e., unlimited) 4: CODE - code executed upon respawn. Passed arguments are [<newVehicle>,<oldVehicle>]. The old vehicle is deleted only after this code is completed. 5: POSITION - type of respawn position: 0 = where it started 1 = where it was destroyed 2 = on vehicle's side respawn marker (e.g., "respawn_vehicle_west") 3 = on BLUFOR respawn marker 4 = on OPFOR respawn marker 5 = on Independent respawn marker 6 = on Civilian respawn marker 7 = on side respawn marker of unit which destroyed the vehicle 6: NUMBER - position selection type (0 = random, 1 = newest, 2 = oldest) 7: NUMBER - type of old vehicle deletion (0 = don't delete, 1 = delete, 2 = delete with an explosion effect) 8: BOOL - true to show notifcation when the vehicle is respawned Returns: BOOL

getposvisual.description: Returns an object's rendered 3D position (z value above sea when over sea, or above ground when over land) in render time scope. Alias of visiblePosition.

bis_fnc_buildingpositions.description: Get all available positions within a building or structure.

bis_fnc_getcfgdatapool.name: BIS_fnc_getCfgDataPool
bis_fnc_getcfgdatapool.description: * Get array of attribute values out of the parent config class. * Attributes need to be in this format: "_n", where n is an index number (starting from 0). * If any discrepancy in indexing is detected, loading will stop and only the correctly indexed values will be returned. * Max. index supported is 99. * If more then 9 attributes used, 0-9 need to use leading zeroes. CFG example: class Timeline { class StageA { _0[] = {2035,7,7,04,30}; _1[] = {2035,7,7,06,15}; _2[] = {2035,7,7,18,35}; _3[] = {2035,7,8,09,05}; _4[] = {2035,7,8,13,25}; _5[] = {2035,7,8,17,10}; _6[] = {2035,7,8,21,40}; _7[] = {2035,7,9,19,55}; }; }; Remark(s): * Can by called 2 ways: * 1st way (general) works for any config. * 2nd way is for comfortable working with mission description.ext. Parameter(s): _this: CFG _this: ARRAY of STRINGS - missionConfigFile classes. Example: * 1st way of calling: _array = (configfile >> "BulletBubbles" >> "BulletBubbles1") call BIS_fnc_getCfgData; _array = (missionconfigfile >> "Timeline" >> "StageA") call BIS_fnc_getCfgData; * 2nd way of calling: _array = ["Timeline","StageA"] call BIS_fnc_getCfgData; Returns: ARRAY or nil, if parent class is not found

unitaddons.name: unitAddons
unitaddons.description: Returns list with addons the unit belongs to.

removecuratoraddons.name: removeCuratorAddons
removecuratoraddons.description: Restrict curator use of given addons.

bis_fnc_tridentgetrelationship.name: BIS_fnc_tridentGetRelationship
bis_fnc_tridentgetrelationship.description: Description: Get relationship of competing Trident sides. The value slowly decreases towards 0.

bis_fnc_healing.name: BIS_fnc_healing
bis_fnc_healing.description: Healing postprocess. Supposed to give healing postprocess effects.

addvest.name: addVest
addvest.description: Create a new vest and try to link it into vest slot.

bis_fnc_bloodeffect.name: BIS_fnc_bloodEffect
bis_fnc_bloodeffect.description: Adds the bleeding effect post-processing effect to the players screen.
bis_fnc_bloodeffect.example: [10] call BIS_fnc_bloodEffect; // Adds the blood effect for 10 (milli)seconds.

roadat.name: roadAt
roadat.description: Returns road segment at given position, objNull otherwise. Same as isOnRoad only returns the actual road object instead of boolean.

rightParam.name: position
rightParam.description: array, in which case Z will be automatically deduced as the height of the road surface

params.description: array, in which case Z will be automatically deduced as the height of the road surface

syntaxes.returnDescription: road segment or objNull

bis_fnc_setidcstreamfriendly.name: BIS_fnc_setIDCStreamFriendly
bis_fnc_setidcstreamfriendly.description: Shows or hides UI control according to state of the Stream Friendly UI switch in Game Options.

itemswithmagazines.name: itemsWithMagazines
itemswithmagazines.description: Returns combined array including all unit's items and all unit's magazines. Loaded magazines such as currentMagazine, primaryWeaponMagazine, secondaryWeaponMagazine, handgunMagazine as well as assignedItems are excluded.
itemswithmagazines.example: itemsWithMagazines player //is essentially the same as items player + magazines player [ "FirstAidKit", //item "30Rnd_65x39_caseless_mag", //magazine "16Rnd_9x21_Mag", //magazine "Chemlight_green", //magazine "HandGrenade", //magazine "ToolKit", //item "MineDetector" //item ]

enablechannel.name: enableChannel
enablechannel.description: Enables/disables UI functionality which is responsible for sending text or voice chat to the given chat channel. If the channel was disabled in description.ext, it can be enabled with this command, however the UI functionality changes will be local to the PC executing this command. What this command cannot do:
enablechannel.example: 0 enableChannel false; // Disable user ability to send voice and text on global channel

rightParam.name: enable
rightParam.description: true to enable, false to disable (both VoN and chat)

params.name: enable
params.description: true to enable, false to disable (both VoN and chat)

params.name: enableMapMarkers
params.description: true to enable map marker placement

params.name: enableMapDrawing
params.description: true to enable drawing on the map

setdetailmapblendpars.name: setDetailMapBlendPars
setdetailmapblendpars.description: Sets the detail texture map blend pars. Allows for smooth transition between detailed and undetailed terrain texture at distance. If noDetail > fullDetail, the texture detail will incur smooth transition in the area between the thresholds. If noDetail <= fullDetail there will be obvious visible edge between texture detail changes at fullDetail distance.

params.name: fullDetail
params.description: threshold distance in metres up to which the terrain will have full texture detail

params.name: noDetail
params.description: threshold distance in metres after which the texture detail will be switched off

bis_fnc_formatcuratorchallengeobjects.name: BIS_fnc_formatCuratorChallengeObjects
bis_fnc_formatcuratorchallengeobjects.description: Format the list of objects compatible with curator challenge to be displayed in the task descriptipon.

get3denselected.name: get3DENSelected
get3denselected.description: Returns an array of all selected Eden Editor Entities of the given type, or, if empty string "" is used, an array of 6 arrays in the following format:
get3denselected.example: systemChat str (get3DENSelected ""); /* outputs: [ [B Alpha 2-1:1],//objects [B Alpha 2-1],//groups [164494: <no shape>],//triggers [<No center> Charlie 1-2:4],//logic [ [B Alpha 2-1,0] ],//waypoints ["Hotel_Whiskey"]//markers ]*/

bis_fnc_missionhandlers.name: BIS_fnc_missionHandlers
bis_fnc_missionhandlers.description: #define VAR_RELOADS (missionname + "_reloads_" + str ismultiplayer) //--- Mission end type and rating

bis_fnc_execvm.name: BIS_fnc_execVM
bis_fnc_execvm.description: execVM desired script with desired argument(s). This function is only really useful when combined with BIS_fnc_MP to execute a script remotely.

removeitemfromuniform.name: removeItemFromUniform
removeitemfromuniform.description: Removes item from soldier's uniform. Can be used with magazines and weapons too.

bis_fnc_addvirtualweaponcargo.name: BIS_fnc_addVirtualWeaponCargo
bis_fnc_addvirtualweaponcargo.description: Add virtual weapons to an object (e.g., ammo box). Virtual items can be selected in the Arsenal.

bis_fnc_modulesector.name: BIS_fnc_moduleSector
bis_fnc_modulesector.description: Initialize a sector module. Can be also used to get sector parameters. --- Get all sectors --- Parameter(s): 0: BOOL Returns: ARRAY of OBJECTs --- Get number of sectors held by a side --- Parameter(s): 0: SIDE Returns: NUMBER - number of sectors owned by the side --- Set sector owner --- Parameter(s): 0: OBJECT - sector module 1: SIDE Returns: BOOL --- Initialize --- Parameter(s): 0: OBJECT - sector module Returns: NOTHING

is3den.name: is3DEN
is3den.description: Returns true if the Eden Editor is currently being used. true when inside editor environment, false during preview. (see also is3DENMultiplayer)
is3den.example: if is3DEN then {systemChat "Welcome to Eden Editor!"};

syntaxes.returnDescription: true when inside editor environment, false when outside of editor environment

getpilotcamerarotation.name: getPilotCameraRotation
getpilotcamerarotation.description: Returns rotation (relative to the centered camera position) of the object airplane or helicopter pilotCamera .

curatoreditingareatype.name: curatorEditingAreaType
curatoreditingareatype.description: Returns type of edit areas assigned to curator (blacklist/whitelist).

isobjectrtd.name: isObjectRTD
isobjectrtd.description: Returns true if RTD model is loaded

bis_fnc_preload.name: BIS_fnc_preload
bis_fnc_preload.description: Start automatic loading screen upon mission start. On client, it will finish only when server is finished.

primaryweaponmagazine.name: primaryWeaponMagazine
primaryweaponmagazine.description: Returns array containing class name of currently loaded primary weapon magazine (or magazines in case of weapon having grenade launcher), otherwise it returns []. This command is used for infantry weapons only.

removeheadgear.description: Removes headgear from a unit. If unit has no headgear command quietly fails.

removemusiceventhandler.description: Removes specified music track event handler.

setammoonpylon.description: Set count of ammo in magazine on pylon

params.description: pylon index (index starts from 1) or pylon name (see getCompatiblePylonMagazines Example 4)

setvehiclereportremotetargets.description: Sets that the vehicle will share targets that were acquired by its own sensors via datalink to the Side center.

queryitemspool.name: queryItemsPool
queryitemspool.description: Returns the number of items of type in the weapon pool (used in campaigns to transfer weapons to the next mission).

bis_fnc_tasksettype.name: BIS_fnc_taskSetType
bis_fnc_tasksettype.description: Sets task type to given task. Parameters: 0: STRING - task id 1: STRING - task type Returns: STRING - task id

velocitymodelspace.name: velocityModelSpace
velocitymodelspace.description: Returns the velocity (speed vector) of the vehicle as an array with format [x, y, z]. Vector is in model space.
velocitymodelspace.example: velocityModelSpace _chopper; comment "Returns [X (left(-) right(+)), Y (backward(-) forward(+)), Z (down(-) up(+))]";

load.name: load
load.description: Returns current sum of mass from items stored in all unit's containers. Load is calculated by the following formula: _loadPlayer = loadAbs player / getNumber (configFile >> "CfgInventoryGlobalVariable" >> "maxSoldierLoad");

checkvisibility.name: checkVisibility
checkvisibility.description: Checks if one position is visible from another position and how much. The results can be affected by getTerrainGrid value, especially if position is near the ground. Particle effects such as smoke can also affect the results.

params.name: LOD
params.description: level of details to use. Possible values are: `"FIRE"`, `"VIEW"`, `"GEOM"`, `"IFIRE"`, and {{GVI|arma3|2.02|size= 0.75}} `"PHYSX"`
