addtorque.description: Applies torque (rotation momentum) to the center of mass of the given object. Torque force is defined as vector [x, y, z] applied in world space. If you need to define torque in model space, convert the torque vector first by vectorModelToWorld or vectorModelToWorldVisual command. The torque applied as impulse. Diagram below explain which way the object would rotate. For more information see NVIDIA docs

bis_fnc_damagechanged.description: Handle effects caused by changing of damage.

bis_fnc_setovercast.description: Instantly set weather conditions and share it across network. Must be executed in scheduled environment.

bis_fnc_moveaction.description: Return current move action (used in playAction, playActionNow and switchAction)

setparticlefire.description: Set fire parameters to particle effect. Note: You need to create emitter at first. Basic parameters of particle effect must be defined too. ctrlsetfontsecondary.description: Sets the font size of the secondary text of given control.

ctrlanimatemodel.name: ctrlAnimateModel
ctrlanimatemodel.description: Process an animation of 3D Dialog Control. Command uses name defined by source property and works similar like animateSource command.

tvadd.name: tvAdd
tvadd.description: Adds an item with given text to Tree View control. The position on Tree View where to add the item and the actual path to this item once added are different. bis_fnc_initmodules.description: Wait until all modules using the Arma 3 Module Framework are initialized.

getshotparents.description: Returns shot information Array for the given projectile in format [vehicle, instigator], where vehicle is the vehicle the shot was fired from, and the instigator is the person who pulled the trigger. If shot was fired by a soldier on foot or in FFV position in vehicle, the soldier is returned for the vehicle.

bis_fnc_configextremes.description: Scan config paths and return min and max values for each property.

bis_fnc_sideisenemy.description: Determines if side B is enemy to side A the way the game engine does it. The relationship table can be found here: Side relations.

bis_fnc_scriptedwaypointtype.description: Return CfgWaypoints type of scripted waypoint. Returns empty string/config when waypoint is not scripted Returns "Custom"/CfgWaypoints root when waypoint is using custom script.

vectordirvisual.description: Return object's normalized direction vector in world space ([x,y,z]) in render time scope.

setcollisionlight.description: Switches collision lights of a vehicle on/off. Note that the vehicle has to be local.

bis_fnc_changesupportradiochannel.description: Changes the radio channel for Support module-related protocol. Parameter(s): _this select 0: SIDE - Affected side _this select 1: ANY - Channel setting Returns: nothing

This command also supports hexagon area which can be created from ellipse when both a and b are negative. Hexagon ellipses are also supported by both marker creation and drawEllipse.

unassignitem.example: bluforUnit unassignItem "NVGoggles"; bluforUnit removeItem "NVGoggles"; opforUnit unassignItem "NVGoggles_OPFOR"; opforUnit removeItem "NVGoggles_OPFOR"; independentUnit unassignItem "NVGoggles_INDEP"; independentUnit removeItem "NVGoggles_INDEP";

addprimaryweaponitem.name: addPrimaryWeaponItem
addprimaryweaponitem.description: Adds weapon item to the weapon cargo space. This is used for infantry weapons.

syntaxes.returnDescription: '''false''' is returned if '''item''' can not be added

assigneditems.name: assignedItems
assigneditems.description: Get array with all assigned items.

params.name: allItems
params.description: true to include all slot items, false exclude goggles and headgear

params.name: includeBinocs
params.description: true to include binoculars (which is a weapon), false to exclude it

magazinesdetailuniform.name: magazinesDetailUniform
magazinesdetailuniform.description: Returns an array with the type names of all the unit's uniform magazines.

params.name: includeLoaded
params.description: true to include magazines loaded in weapons (Since Arma 3 v2.07.148195)

setwindstr.name: setWindStr
setwindstr.description: Changes the wind strength smoothly during the given time (in seconds). A time of zero means there will be an immediate change.
setwindstr.example: 60 setWindStr 0.8; // set the wind strength to 0.8 gradually over the next 60 seconds

vectorcos.name: vectorCos
vectorcos.description: Cosine of angle between two 3D vectors.

rightParam.name: vector2

params.description: When Vector2D is provided the z coordinate is defaulted to 0

params.description: When Vector2D is provided the z coordinate is defaulted to 0

ropeattachedto.name: ropeAttachedTo
ropeattachedto.description: Returns the ropes owner to which other objects are attached with ropes. This command is the opposite of ropeAttachedObjects.

rightParam.name: cargo
rightParam.description: entity attached to the end of the first rope

params.name: cargo
params.description: entity attached to the end of the first rope

syntaxes.returnDescription: a transport from which the first rope originates, the rope owner

bis_fnc_vreffectkilled.name: BIS_fnc_VREffectKilled
bis_fnc_vreffectkilled.description: Delete body of a virtual soldier after he's killed.

enabledynamicsimulationsystem.name: enableDynamicSimulationSystem
enabledynamicsimulationsystem.description: Enables or disables the whole Arma_3_Dynamic_Simulation system

backpackcargo.name: backpackCargo
backpackcargo.description: Get array with backpacks from ammo box (or any general weapon holder container).

syntaxes.returnDescription: class names ["BackpackType1", "BackpackType1", "BackpackType2", ...]

handgunitems.name: handgunItems
handgunitems.description: Returns array with all items assigned to the handgun. This command is used for infantry weapons only.

syntaxes.returnDescription: [silencer, laserpointer/flashlight, optics, bipod]

lbsetselectcolor.name: lbSetSelectColor
lbsetselectcolor.description: Sets the select color of the item with the given index of the listbox or combobox with id idc of the topmost user dialog to color.

disableremotesensors.name: disableRemoteSensors
disableremotesensors.description: This command will halt raycasting calculations (on the local machine only) for all groups which don't contain any local entities. If a group contains a single local entity then calculations will still be performed for the entire group.

getfuelcargo.name: getFuelCargo
getfuelcargo.description: Returns the fuel amount (between 0 and 1) in the cargo space of a refuelling vehicle.

syntaxes.returnDescription: fuel cargo value, -1 if fuel cargo is not supported, 0 if the vehicle is !alive or isNull

bis_fnc_effectkilledsecondaries.name: BIS_fnc_effectKilledSecondaries
bis_fnc_effectkilledsecondaries.description: //Small secondary fuel explosions //By Maddmatt for ArmA 2

groupfromnetid.name: groupFromNetId
groupfromnetid.description: Get group with given unique ID. For objects use objectFromNetId. As this command is MP only, you can use BIS_fnc_groupFromNetId, which extends the use to SP as well.

stance.name: stance
stance.description: Returns the stance of the given unit. It can be one of:

syntaxes.returnDescription:
can be:
* `"STAND"`
* `"CROUCH"`
* `"PRONE"`
* `"UNDEFINED"` (for example, swimming)
* `""` (on non-person object)

bis_fnc_modulesavegame.name: BIS_fnc_moduleSaveGame
bis_fnc_modulesavegame.description: Saves the game. Saving has to be enabled.

bis_fnc_missionrespawntype.name: BIS_fnc_missionRespawnType
bis_fnc_missionrespawntype.description: Return respawn type defined in Description.ext. Can return as Number (e.g 1) or String (e.g "BIRD").

setgusts.name: setGusts
setgusts.description: Changes the gusts value smoothly during the given time (in seconds). A time of zero means there will be an immediate change. Value is 0 to 1.

getusermfdtext.name: getUserMFDText
getusermfdtext.description: Returns array of user text variables used in MFD.

vectormodeltoworld.name: vectorModelToWorld
vectormodeltoworld.description: Converts vector direction from model to world space.
vectormodeltoworld.example: Convert model space vector [0,-10,4] to world space; vector gets rotated according to _airplane: _airplane vectorModelToWorld [0,-10,4];

rightParam.name: modelDir
rightParam.description: vector direction in model space in format [x,y,z]

params.name: modelDir
params.description: vector direction in model space in format [x,y,z]

syntaxes.returnDescription: vector direction in world space

settimemultiplier.name: setTimeMultiplier
settimemultiplier.description: Sets a time multiplier for in-game time. The command range is now capped at 0.1 - 120 to avoid performance problems.

pitch.name: pitch
pitch.description: Returns the pitch of a persons voice.

drawpolygon.name: drawPolygon
drawpolygon.description: Draws given polygon on the given map control with given color. The polygon must consist of at least 3 points. Unlike with other draw<shape> commands and due to complexity, this command does not support filling of the polygon with color. Use drawTriangle command to construct and fill polygon shape as a workaround.
drawpolygon.example: test_polygon = []; for "_i" from 1 to 12 do { test_polygon pushBack (player getPos [10 + random 100, 360/_i]); }; findDisplay 12 displayCtrl 51 ctrlAddEventHandler ["Draw", { _this select 0 drawPolygon [test_polygon, [0,0,1,1]]; }];

bis_fnc_modulechat.name: BIS_fnc_moduleChat
bis_fnc_modulechat.description: Make a list of units use any *chat command (groupChat, vehicleChat, sideChat, commandChat, globalChat).
bis_fnc_modulechat.example: myLogic setVariable ["Channel", "2"]; myLogic setVariable ["Text", "Hello everyone, this is side chat!"]; [myLogic, [player], true] call BIS_fnc_moduleChat;

bis_fnc_ordinalnumber.name: BIS_fnc_ordinalNumber
bis_fnc_ordinalnumber.description: Return number as ordinal number (e.g. 1 become "1st")
bis_fnc_ordinalnumber.example: _second = [42] call BIS_fnc_ordinalNumber; // will return "42nd" for English-speaking players

bis_fnc_curatorobjectregistered.name: BIS_fnc_curatorObjectRegistered
bis_fnc_curatorobjectregistered.description: Register "curatorObjectRegistered" handler. Cost of vehicles with crews will be automatically calculated based on vehicle + crew cost.

drawline3d.name: drawLine3D
drawline3d.description: Draws a line of a given color between two 3D positions. Command has to be executed each frame. Use onEachFrame or addMissionEventHandler "Draw3D".

bis_fnc_initvehicle.name: BIS_fnc_initVehicle
bis_fnc_initvehicle.description: This function changes the textures, animation sources and/or mass of a given vehicle.

bis_fnc_exporteditorpreviews.name: BIS_fnc_exportEditorPreviews
bis_fnc_exporteditorpreviews.syntax: [duration, type, sides, mods, addons] spawn BIS_fnc_exportEditorPreviews
bis_fnc_exporteditorpreviews.description: Export screeenshots of objects for Eden Editor and Community Wiki to <Arma 3 Profile>\Screenshots\EditorPreviews directory.

bis_fnc_exportcuratorcosttable.name: BIS_fnc_exportCuratorCostTable
bis_fnc_exportcuratorcosttable.description: Generate spreadsheet with object classes and copy it to clipboard. The table will generate export code to be used in BIS_fnc_curatorObjectRegisteredTable Parameter(s): 0 (Optional): ARRAY of STRINGs - supported addons (classes from CfgPatches). When empty, all preloaded addons will be added. Use empty string to export just the cost calculation. 1 (Optional): STRING - format, can be "ods" or "xls" 2 (Optional): STRING - name of sheet with cost calculation. When empty, the calculation will be inserted on top of the table 3 (Optional): ARRAY of SIDEs or NUMBERs - filter only objects of listed sides or side IDs. Supported sides are west, east, resistance, civilian, sideUnknown and sideLogic 4 (Optional): CODE - condition for class to be listed. Config path to the class is passed as an argument (default: {true}) 5 (Optional): CODE - default cost, must return STRING. When empty string is returned, no default cost will be used (default: {""}) Returns: BOOL

disableuavconnectability.name: disableUAVConnectability
disableuavconnectability.description: Disables unit's AV terminal(s) connecting to UAV.

params.name: checkAllItems
params.description: true to disable all terminals in unit's inventory, false to only disable the currently assigned terminal.

pushbackunique.name: pushBackUnique
pushbackunique.description: Adds element to the back of the given array but only if it is unique to the array. The index of the added element is returned upon success, otherwise -1. This command modifies the original array.

syntaxes.returnDescription: index of inserted element or -1

bis_fnc_showcuratorfeedbackmessage.name: BIS_fnc_showCuratorFeedbackMessage
bis_fnc_showcuratorfeedbackmessage.description: Show feedback message when illegal operation is attempted in curator interface.

ctsetdata.name: ctSetData
ctsetdata.description: Associates metadata (string) with the row determined by the index. Returns Nothing.

commandartilleryfire.name: commandArtilleryFire
commandartilleryfire.description: Orders a unit to reload defined magazine commence fire burst on the given position (via the radio).

params.name: type
params.description: magazine class name from CfgMagazines (case sensitive).

isbleeding.name: isBleeding
isbleeding.description: Returns whether the unit is bleeding.
isbleeding.example: if (isBleeding player) then { player groupChat "I'm bleeding!!"; }

removeweaponglobal.name: removeWeaponGlobal
removeweaponglobal.description: Remove a weapon from a unit. An attempt to remove a weapon, which is not in unit's possession, is simply ignored.

params.name: autoselect
params.description: false to abort weapon autoselection when removing primary weapon.

groupowner.name: groupOwner
groupowner.description: Returns ID of client to which the group is local. Can be run only from server. When called from client, it always returns 0

gethitindex.name: getHitIndex
gethitindex.description: Return current level of damage for a specific Hit Point (specified by its hit part index). All hit points can be obtained with getAllHitPointsDamage command.

rightParam.name: hitPartIndex
rightParam.description: hit part index of the Hit Point

params.name: hitPartIndex
params.description: hit part index of the Hit Point

syntaxes.returnDescription: before {{GVI|arma3|1.94|size= 0.75}}, Nothing was returned when an invalid ''selection'' was provided (now returns `0`)

tvsettooltip.name: tvSetTooltip
tvsettooltip.description: Sets the tooltip text associated with the specified tree view path.

params.name: idc
params.description: IDC of the tree view control

pixelgridbase.name: pixelGridBase
pixelgridbase.description: Returns grid size based on screen resolution.

syntaxes.returnDescription: grid size, see Arma 3: Pixel Grid System

lbsetpicturecolorselected.name: lbSetPictureColorSelected
lbsetpicturecolorselected.description: Sets the selected color of item's picture (left) with the given index of the listbox with id idc of the topmost user dialog to the given color. Color is in format Color. Color which consists from only zeros means disable this override.

bis_fnc_sidecolor.name: BIS_fnc_sideColor
bis_fnc_sidecolor.description: Returns colour of define side either as Array in format RGBA or the name of the colour as String

soldiermagazines.name: soldierMagazines
soldiermagazines.description: Get array with all magazines of the given unit.

setsuppression.name: setSuppression
setsuppression.description: Sets the person's suppression, from 0 to 1.

enabledynamicsimulation.name: enableDynamicSimulation
enabledynamicsimulation.description: Enables or disables Arma_3_Dynamic_Simulation for given non AI object

shownhud.name: shownHUD
shownhud.description: Returns array of Booleans corresponding to the visibility of various HUD elements (see extended showHUD).

syntaxes.returnDescription:
show scripted HUD such as weapon crosshair, action menu and overlays created with cutRsc and titleRsc
* info: Boolean - (Optional, default true) show vehicle, soldier and weapon info
* radar: Boolean - (Optional, default true) show vehicle radar
* compass: Boolean - (Optional, default true) show vehicle compass
* direction: Boolean - (Optional, default true) show tank direction indicator. Not present in vanilla {{arma3}}
* menu: Boolean - (Optional, default true) show commanding menu (HC related menus)
* group: Boolean - (Optional, default true) show group info bar (Squad leader info bar)
* cursors: Boolean - (Optional, default true) show HUD weapon cursors (connected with scripted HUD)
* panels: Boolean - (Optional, default true) show Arma 3: Custom Info
* kills: Boolean - (Optional, default true) show "x killed by y" systemChat messages
* icon3d: Boolean - (Optional, default false) show icons drawn with drawIcon3D even when the HUD is hidden

bis_fnc_fadeeffect.name: BIS_fnc_fadeEffect
bis_fnc_fadeeffect.syntax: [fadeInOrOut, blackOrWhite, duration, blur, music, ending, success] call BIS_fnc_fadeEffect
bis_fnc_fadeeffect.description: Easily carry out complex fading. Default values will be used if parameters aren't defined or set to nil.

weaponsitems.description: Returns an array with subarrays contains class names and also names of connected items of all the vehicle's weapons.

bis_fnc_isunitvirtual.name: BIS_fnc_isUnitVirtual
bis_fnc_isunitvirtual.description: Return if unit is virtual (used for example for Zeus players).

isremoteexecuted.name: isRemoteExecuted
isremoteexecuted.description: Returns true if the code context is being remote executed by remoteExec or remoteExecCall. In SP always returns false. See also isRemoteExecutedJIP

getclientstatenumber.description: Returns client state in network game. Works on both, client and dedicated server. The following states are possible:

syntaxes.returnDescription: client state (see table above)

bis_fnc_ondiarychanged.name: BIS_fnc_onDiaryChanged
bis_fnc_ondiarychanged.description: Register code to be executed when diary item changes. Arguments passed into code are: 0: DISPLAY - map display 1: BOOL - true if clicked on subject list, false when on record list (clicking on subject may also trigger record) 2: STRING - subject name 3: STRING - record name 4: ANY - passed arguments (index of onDiaryChanged code when no custom arguments were used) Parameter(s): _this: CODE ARRAY - code with custom arguments in format [CODE,ARG1,ARG2,...] NUMBER - remove code of given index Returns: NUMBER - index of onDiaryChanged code

bis_fnc_curatorwaypointplaced.name: BIS_fnc_curatorWaypointPlaced
bis_fnc_curatorwaypointplaced.description: Code executed when curator waypoint is placed.

bis_fnc_modulefdfademarker.name: BIS_fnc_moduleFDFadeMarker
bis_fnc_modulefdfademarker.description: Gradually change the alpha of the given marker.

bis_fnc_setrespawndelay.name: BIS_fnc_setRespawnDelay
bis_fnc_setrespawndelay.description: Increase the respawn time based on a condition Parameter(s): 0: CODE - Condition, must return BOOL 1: NUMBER - delay in seconds which is applied when the condition is true 2: STRING - description displayed when the delay is in effect Returns: NOTHING

bis_fnc_initparams.name: BIS_fnc_initParams
bis_fnc_initparams.description: Initialize mission params and create log in the diary.

animationsourcephase.name: animationSourcePhase
animationsourcephase.description: Returns current animation phase of given source. Similar to animationPhase or doorPhase but designed to complement animateSource. This command could be used to obtain relative turret direction and gun elevation on a vehicle (see Example 2)

sendaumessage.name: sendAUMessage
sendaumessage.description: Send the command to the list of clients.

get3dengrid.name: get3DENGrid
get3dengrid.description: Returns the grid increment for the given transformation type.

animatebay.name: animateBay
animatebay.description: Force animation of bay to given state, -1 for reset to engine handling, can cause weapon inoperative, because weapon is released when bay state =1.

params.name: bay
params.description: bay index (index starts from 1 and different from pylon index)

bis_fnc_ambientanimcombat.name: BIS_fnc_ambientAnimCombat
bis_fnc_ambientanimcombat.syntax: [unit, animationset, equipmentlevel, condition, behaviour] call BIS_fnc_ambientAnimCombat;
bis_fnc_ambientanimcombat.description: Play set of ambient animations on given unit AND allows the unit to leave the ambient state and engage enemy or move away.

bis_fnc_orbatremovegroupoverlay.name: BIS_fnc_ORBATRemoveGroupOverlay
bis_fnc_orbatremovegroupoverlay.description: Unregister texture(s) to be displayed over CfgORBAT group.

additemcargo.name: addItemCargo
additemcargo.description: Creates new items and stores them in given container. Works with items, weapons and magazines. For global variant see addItemCargoGlobal

params.name: count
params.description: number of items to add; {{GVI|arma3|2.14|size= 0.75}} a negative value removes items

tvsetpicturerightcolordisabled.name: tvSetPictureRightColorDisabled
tvsetpicturerightcolordisabled.description: Sets the color of the right picture of a tree item defined by path when item is disabled

bis_fnc_livefeedsetsource.name: BIS_fnc_liveFeedSetSource
bis_fnc_livefeedsetsource.description: Set the source of the current live feed.

moonphase.name: moonPhase
moonphase.description: Returns the phase of the in-game Moon on the given date in range 0...1, where 0 - new Moon, 1 - full Moon. According to this command the fullest Moon in Arma 3 at midnight is on setDate [4804,7,13,0,0]; Use Moon Phase Utility to find out date for a mission with desired moon.

syntaxes.returnDescription: 0 = new Moon, 1 = full Moon

ctrlhtmlloaded.name: ctrlHTMLLoaded
ctrlhtmlloaded.description: Returns true when HTML content was successfully loaded.
ctrlhtmlloaded.example: _control htmlLoad "test.html"; if (!ctrlHTMLLoaded _control) then { hint "Loading test.html failed!"; };

setrandomlip.name: setRandomLip
setrandomlip.description: Enables/Disables random lip. When enabled, the unit continuously moves its lips as if it's talking.

bis_fnc_radialred.name: BIS_fnc_radialRed
bis_fnc_radialred.description: Red radial postprocess (hit damage, fire damage). Parameters are the same as the first four of HandleDamage EH.

modeltoworldvisual.name: modelToWorldVisual
modeltoworldvisual.description: Converts position from object model space to world space in render time scope. For ASL version see modelToWorldVisualWorld.

rightParam.name: modelPos
rightParam.description: in format PositionRelative ([x,y,z] offset relative to the model centre)

params.name: modelPos
params.description: in format PositionRelative ([x,y,z] offset relative to the model centre)

syntaxes.returnDescription: world position

ctrlmodel.name: ctrlModel
ctrlmodel.description: Returns model used in 3D Dialog Control.

syntaxes.returnDescription: model path

diag_activescripts.name: diag_activeScripts
diag_activescripts.description: Returns 4 element array with numbers of currently running scripts in format: [spawn-ed, execVM-ed, exec-ed, execFSM-ed]

syntaxes.returnDescription:
The number of scripts running with spawn
* execVM: Number - The number of scripts running with execVM
* exec: Number - The number of scripts running with exec
* execFSM: Number - The number of scripts running with execFSM

addmissioneventhandler.name: addMissionEventHandler
addmissioneventhandler.description: Adds event handler (EH) attached to the current mission and returns EH handle. If EH has some data to return upon event, it is passed in _this variable. Since Arma 3 v.1.63.137807 the EH handle is also stored in _thisEventHandler variable and is available during EH code execution.
addmissioneventhandler.example: // A script could be executed to stop custom scripts graciously, or save progress & stats, for example: _id = addMissionEventHandler ["Ended",{ _this execVM "missionEnded.sqf" }];

params.name: arguments
params.description: additional arguments to be passed to the EH code. Available during code execution via `_thisArgs` variable.

syntaxes.returnDescription: the index of the currently added mission event handler is returned

setvehicleammodef.name: setVehicleAmmoDef
setvehicleammodef.description: Sets how much ammunition (compared to the configuration of magazines defined in the vehicle's class) the vehicle has. Note that the ammo will only be added to local turrets. To check the locality of turret use turretLocal.

disablemapindicators.name: disableMapIndicators
disablemapindicators.description: Command allows suppressing visualization of FRIENDLY, ENEMY, MINES and/or PING map indicators from difficulty setting EXTENDED MAP CONTENT.
disablemapindicators.example: Disable visualization of friendly and enemy units:disableMapIndicators [true,true,false,false];

params.name: disableFriendly
params.description: true to disable visualization of friendly units

params.name: disableEnemy
params.description: true to disable visualization of enemy units

params.name: disableMines
params.description: true to disable visualization of mines

params.name: disablePing
params.description: true to disable visualization of all tactical pings

bis_fnc_romannumeral.name: BIS_fnc_romanNumeral
bis_fnc_romannumeral.description: Convert integer to roman numeral (e.g. 42 becomes "XLII").

ctrlsetfontheightsecondary.name: ctrlSetFontHeightSecondary
ctrlsetfontheightsecondary.description: Sets the font size of the secondary text of given control.

turretowner.name: turretOwner
turretowner.description: Returns id of the owner of the turret. Server only. Returns 0 on non-server and SP.

syntaxes.returnDescription: owner id

shownuavfeed.name: shownUAVFeed
shownuavfeed.description: Returns true if video feed transmitted from UAV is shown. A getter for showUAVFeed

setammo.name: setAmmo
setammo.description: Sets custom ammo count in the currently loaded magazine of the specified weapon. The unit must be local to the computer where command is executed.
setammo.example: Set player's handgun magazine ammo count to 10 rounds: player setAmmo [handgunWeapon player, 10];

params.name: weaponOrMuzzle
params.description: weapon name. Muzzle name in case the weapon has more than one muzzle, e.g. weapon with grenade launcher. See CfgWeapons for muzzle names

isweapondeployed.name: isWeaponDeployed
isweapondeployed.description: Returns true if weapon is currently deployed.

params.name: onGround
params.description: true to check if deployed on ground, false to check if deployed on object. Omitted - same as main syntax.

bis_fnc_diagknowntargets.name: BIS_fnc_diagKnownTargets
bis_fnc_diagknowntargets.description: Visualize and profile which units one specific unit knows about and how much. Calling function again stops diagnostics.

removemagazineglobal.name: removeMagazineGlobal
removemagazineglobal.description: Removes the magazine from the unit.

ctrlclassname.name: ctrlClassName
ctrlclassname.description: Returns the class name of a Control as it is defined in config. If you need config class of a game created Display, it is stored on display itself: _className = findDisplay 12 getVariable ["BIS_fnc_initDisplay_configClass", ""]; // "RscDiary"
ctrlclassname.example: List class names of all controls present on display 46:_ctrls = ""; for "_i" from -1 to 10000 do { with uiNamespace do { _ctrl = findDisplay 46 displayCtrl _i; if (!isNull _ctrl) then { _ctrls = _ctrls + format ["IDC:Â %1, Class Name:Â %2\n", _i, ctrlClassName _ctrl]; }; }; }; hint _ctrls;

syntaxes.returnDescription: class name

bis_fnc_countdown.name: BIS_fnc_countdown
bis_fnc_countdown.description: Triggers a countdown. Countdown can be accessed via missionNamespace variable bis_fnc_countdown_time

bis_fnc_openfieldmanual.name: BIS_fnc_openFieldManual
bis_fnc_openfieldmanual.description: Opens Field Manual in briefing (SP, MP Server, MP Client) and players's map or journal. Selects the topic and hint passed as parameters. Can apply a (search) filter if desired.

slingloadassistantshown.name: slingLoadAssistantShown
slingloadassistantshown.description: Returns true of Sling Load Assistant is open
slingloadassistantshown.example: waitUntil {slingLoadAssistantShown}; hint "You lack rudimentary motor skills and basic eye-hand coordination."; //scold user for unethical practices

syntaxes.returnDescription: true if sling load assistant is shown, false otherwise

removeallassigneditems.name: removeAllAssignedItems
removeallassigneditems.description: Unassigns and deletes all linked items from inventory. The commands operates on assignedItems array, which doesnt include goggles or headgear. Use removeGoggles and removeHeadgear for those.

params.name: allItems
params.description: true to include all slot items, false exclude goggles and headgear

params.name: includeBinocs
params.description: true to include binoculars (which is a weapon), false to exclude it

bis_fnc_activateaddons.name: BIS_fnc_activateAddons
bis_fnc_activateaddons.description: Activate addons upon mission start. Doesn't work when the mission is already running.

get3denlayerentities.name: get3DENLayerEntities
get3denlayerentities.description: Return all entities and sub-layer in Eden Entity layer.

rightParam.name: layerID
rightParam.description: layer ID as returned by add3DENLayer command

params.name: layerID
params.description: layer ID as returned by add3DENLayer command

bis_fnc_progressloadingscreen.name: BIS_fnc_progressLoadingScreen
bis_fnc_progressloadingscreen.description: Progress scripted loading screen. The value will be preserved even when a new screen is opened.

bis_fnc_isthrowable.name: BIS_fnc_isThrowable
bis_fnc_isthrowable.description: Returns true if given magazine is throwable

selectmax.name: selectMax
selectmax.description: Returns the array element with maximum numerical value. Engine solution to BIS_fnc_greatestNum and BIS_fnc_findExtreme. Therefore it is expected that supplied array consists of Numbers only. Booleans however are also supported and will be evaluated as Numbers: true - 1, false - 0. nil value treated as 0. Other non Number elements (not recommended) will be evaluated as 0 and Bad conversion: scalar message will be logged into .rpt.

params.name: jointType
params.description:
currently only "6DOFJoint" and "RevoluteJoint" and "FixedJoint"
; 6DOFJoint : Allows to configure all axis (XYZ translation, Pitch/Yaw/Roll rotation) limits and drives. ; RevoluteJoint : Only allows rotation around the X axis, a Revolute joint can also be implemented with a 6DOFJoint and the appropriate limits (internally it is implemented exactly like that) ; FixedJoint : Limited in all axis, it essentially works like a PhysX based attachTo.

params.name: localFrameParent
params.description:
the Position and orientation, in parent's model-space of where the joint will be placed.
An Array of 3 elements [position, upPos, dirPos]
Each element can either be a Vector (3-element array of Number) or a Memory point name (String).


An important Caveat when using Vectors is that dir and up are not direction vectors, but positions.
Essentially, upPos/dirPos would be the model-space coordinates of where the memory point would be.
For example: ```sqf private _jointPos = [0, 0, 0]; private _vectorDir = [0, 1, 0]; private _vectorUp = [0, 0, 1]; [_jointPos, _jointPos vectorAdd _vectorDir, _jointPos vectorAdd _vectorUp]; ```

params.name: localFrameChild
params.description: the position and orientation, in child's model-space of where the joint will be placed.

params.name: miscFlags
jointDescription
params.description:
this specifies the behavior/limits of the joint.
[(linearLimit, swingLimit, twistLimit, drives)]

Note that all are optional. Passing an empty array is equivalent to using a "FixedJoint" type

; linearLimit : Array - Linear limit specifies the joints permitted translation along the XYZ axis.
There are three types of linear limits, fully locked, per-axis limit and distance limit.

:; Fully Locked: :: []
Empty array, will completely lock the XYZ translational axes, only allowing rotational movement (If allowed in the swing/twist limits) :; Per axis: :: [limitX, limitY, limitZ]
::; limit*: ::: Array - [lowerLimit, upperLimit, springParameters]
:::; lowerLimit: :::: Number - The minimum permitted offset on the axis :::; upperLimit: :::: Number - The maximum permitted offset on the axis
upperLimit must be larger than lowerLimit :::; springParameters: :::: Array - [(restitution, spring, damping)]
All spring parameters are optional, but for the linear limits, atleast an empty array must be provided.
::::; restitiution: ::::: Number (Optional, Default: 0) - Must be between 0-1.
Controls the amount of bounce when the joint hits a limit.
A restitution value of 1.0 causes the joint to bounce back with the velocity which it hit the limit.
A value of zero causes the joint to stop dead.
NVIDIA docs ::::; spring: ::::: Number (Optional, Default: 0) - Must be 0 or greater.
if greater than zero, the limit is soft, i.e. a spring pulls the joint back to the limit ::::; damping: ::::: Number (Optional, Default: 0) - Must be 0 or greater. if spring is greater than zero, this is the damping of the limit spring
::; Distance Limit ::: [xLocked, yLocked, zLocked, distanceLimit, springParameters]
:::; *Locked: :::: Boolean - Whether the axis is completely locked and no translation is allowed along it :::; distanceLimit: :::: Number - Distance on meters, as a radius/sphere around the joint. :; swingLimit: :: Array - [(swingX, swingZ, springParameters)]
All parameters are optional, the default is both swing axis being locked
Swing limit comes in two types, cone and pyramid. Which variant is used depends on the datatype inside the swing parameter
Note that cone cannot be combined with pyramid, either both are cone or both are pyramid.
If the swing limit is pi, the rotation around that axis is fully unlocked/free.
::; Cone limit: ::: swingZ: Number (Optional, Default 0/locked) - The rotation around the Z (up) axis, thus the yaw. Rotation in radians, between pi and pi. ::; ::: swingY: Number (Optional, Default 0/locked) - The rotation around the Y (front/dir) axis, thus the roll. Rotation in radians, between pi and pi. ::; Pyramid limit: ::: swingZ: Array - [(min, max)] - Same rotation in radians as the cone limit, but it can be asymmetrical. ::; ::: swingY: Array - [(min, max)] - Same rotation in radians as the cone limit, but it can be asymmetrical. :; twistLimit: :: Array - [(twistLower, twistUpper, springParameters)]
Twist is rotation about the X (right) axis, thus the pitch.
Left and right twist limits can be configured independently.
::; twist*: ::: Number (Optional, Default: 0) - Rotation limit in radians, between -2pi and 2pi
0 means twist is locked, and 2*pi means its completely unlocked :; drives: :: Array - [(angularSwingDrive, angularTwistDrive, angularSlerpDrive, linearXDrive, linearYDrive, linearZDrive, limitsAreForces)]
Drives allow to apply force into the joint on any of the axes.
Each drive is a spring, one end being on the joint, and the other end being on the target specified by the commands:
setJointDrivePosition setJointDriveOrientation setJointDriveLinearVelocity setJointDriveAngularVelocity
For rotational drives there are two variants, Swing+Twist or SLERP (Spherical Linear Interpolation)
See NVIDIA docs
::; *Drive: ::: Array - [type, spring, damping, forceLimit]
:::; type: :::: Number - MUST be 0 (#TODO acceleration drive implementation?)
:::; spring: :::: Number - Same as springParameters above :::; damping: :::: Number - Same as springParameters above :::; forceLimit: :::: Number - The maximum force this drive c an apply to the joint :; limitsAreForces: :: Boolean (Optional, Default: true) - NOT IMPLEMENTED #TODO?
